rows.source: The thickest string is the lowest. It sits nearest your face when you play. We call it string 6.
rows.translation: Þykkasti strengurinn hefur lægsta tóninn. Hann er næst andlitinu þegar þú spilar. Við köllum hann streng 6.

rows.source: Each string has a tuning peg on the head. Turning it changes the pitch. Timbre listens and tells you which way.
rows.translation: Hver strengur hefur stilliskrúfu á hausnum. Þegar þú snýrð henni breytist tónhæðin. Timbre hlustar og segir þér í hvaða átt á að snúa.

rows.source: E minor uses two fingers on fret 2, strings 5 and 4. Every string rings.
rows.translation: Í E-moll seturðu tvo fingur á band 2, á strengi 5 og 4. Allir strengirnir óma.

rows.source: Brush across all six strings from thick to thin, one smooth motion. Keep your wrist loose.
rows.translation: Renndu yfir alla sex strengina frá þykkum að þunnum í einni mjúkri hreyfingu. Hafðu úlnliðinn lausan.

rows.translation: Þessi áskorun sameinar alla eininguna: opnu strengina, E, F og G á streng 1 og E-moll. Andaðu milli skrefa.

rows.source: Mary Had a Little Lamb needs three notes: open string 2 is B, fret 2 on string 3 is A, and open string 3 is G. Your second finger plays the A.
rows.translation: Í Mary Had a Little Lamb þarf þrjá tóna: opinn strengur 2 er B, band 2 á streng 3 er A og opinn strengur 3 er G. Annar fingur spilar A.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 1 · song gtr-1-6 “Mary Had a Little Lamb: three notes” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: String 3, fret 2, second finger. That's A.
rows.translation: Strengur 3, band 2, annar fingur. Það er A.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 1 · song gtr-1-6 “Mary Had a Little Lamb: three notes” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: B A G A B B B: open string 2, then string 3.
rows.translation: B A G A B B B: opinn strengur 2, svo strengur 3.

rows.source: String 2 works like string 1. Open, it's B. Fret 1 with your first finger is C. Fret 3 with your third finger is D.
rows.translation: Strengur 2 virkar eins og strengur 1. Opinn er hann B. Band 1 með fyrsta fingri er C. Band 3 með þriðja fingri er D.

rows.translation: Plokkaðu opinn streng 2. Það er B.

rows.source: String 2, fret 1, first finger. That's C.
rows.translation: Strengur 2, band 1, fyrsti fingur. Það er C.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 2 · lesson gtr-2-1 “Three notes on string 2” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: String 2, fret 3, third finger. That's D.
rows.translation: Strengur 2, band 3, þriðji fingur. Það er D.

rows.source: One finger per fret: fret 1 gets finger 1, fret 2 gets finger 2, fret 3 gets finger 3.
rows.translation: Einn fingur á hvert band: fingur 1 á band 1, fingur 2 á band 2 og fingur 3 á band 3.

rows.source: Rest your thumb on the back of the neck, behind your second finger. Your fingers can then arch and land on their tips.
rows.translation: Láttu þumalinn hvíla aftan á hálsinum, á móts við annan fingur. Þá geta fingurnir bognað og lent á gómunum.

rows.source: Tab draws six lines, one per string, with string 1 on top. A number on a line is the fret to press. A 0 means play that string open.
rows.translation: Gripnótur hafa sex línur, eina fyrir hvern streng, með streng 1 efst. Tala á línu sýnir bandið sem á að þrýsta á. 0 merkir að spila strenginn opinn.

rows.source: In tab, a 3 on the top line means…
rows.translation: Á gripnótum merkir 3 á efstu línu…

rows.translation: Tónn sem varir í tvö slög

rows.source: A half note rings for two beats. Pick once, count one, two, and let it sustain until the next note.
rows.translation: Hálfnóta ómar í tvö slög. Plokkaðu einu sinni, teldu einn, tveir og láttu tóninn óma þar til næsti kemur.

rows.source: Half of a four-beat bar is two beats. A quarter note lasts one beat.
rows.translation: Helmingur af fjögurra slaga takti er tvö slög. Fjórðapartsnóta varir í eitt slag.

rows.source: Going from string 2 to string 1 is a tiny move. Keep your picking hand close to the strings so the next note is ready.
rows.translation: Það þarf örlitla hreyfingu til að fara af streng 2 á streng 1. Hafðu plokkhöndina nálægt strengjunum, tilbúna fyrir næsta tón.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 2 · lesson gtr-2-3 “Long and short notes” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Fret 3 on string 2, then open string 1. Lift your finger as you pick.
rows.translation: Band 3 á streng 2, svo opinn strengur 1. Lyftu fingrinum um leið og þú plokkar.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 2 · lesson gtr-2-3 “Long and short notes” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.translation: C og D á streng 2, svo E, F og G á streng 1.

rows.source: This melody comes from Beethoven's Ninth Symphony. It uses C, D, E, F and G, and it moves mostly one step at a time.
rows.translation: Þessi laglína kemur úr níundu sinfóníu Beethovens. Hún notar C, D, E, F og G og færist að mestu um eitt tónstigaspor í einu.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 2 · song gtr-2-4 “Ode to Joy” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: The first line, slowly: E E F G G F E D.
rows.translation: Fyrsta línan, hægt: E E F G G F E D.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 2 · song gtr-2-4 “Ode to Joy” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Then: C C D E E D D.
rows.translation: Síðan: C C D E E D D.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 2 · song gtr-2-4 “Ode to Joy” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise
Guitar · Unit 2 · song gtr-2-4 “Ode to Joy” · step 4 (explain) · title

rows.source: Each line ends with a lilt: a longer note, a quick one, then a held one. Count one-and-two, and slip the quick note in on the and.
rows.translation: Hver lína endar með sveiflu: lengri tónn, snöggur tónn og svo tónn sem er haldið. Teldu einn-og-tveir og láttu snögga tóninn koma á og.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 2 · song gtr-2-4 “Ode to Joy” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: This nursery tune walks on C, D and E, then jumps up to G. The jump is open string 1 to fret 3.
rows.translation: Þetta barnalag gengur um C, D og E og stekkur svo upp á G. Stökkið er frá opnum streng 1 upp á band 3.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 2 · song gtr-2-5 “Mary Had a Little Lamb” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: E D C D E E E: open string 1, down to string 2 and back.
rows.translation: E D C D E E E: opinn strengur 1, niður á streng 2 og til baka.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 2 · song gtr-2-5 “Mary Had a Little Lamb” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: D D D on string 2, then E and G on string 1.
rows.translation: D D D á streng 2, svo E og G á streng 1.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 2 · song gtr-2-5 “Mary Had a Little Lamb” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Letters in a Shoebox is a Timbre Original, a slow ballad in C. Its chorus lives on strings 1 and 2, and its hook opens with the long, short lilt you played in Ode to Joy. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
rows.translation: Bréf í skókassa er frumsamið lag frá Timbre, hæg ballada í C. Viðlagið er á strengjum 1 og 2. Grípandi stefið byrjar á sömu löngu-stuttu sveiflu og þú spilaðir í laginu Óðurinn til gleðinnar. Allt lagið er á flipanum Lög, undir Frumsamin lög.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 2 · lesson gtr-2-spotlight “Song spotlight: Letters in a Shoebox” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: The hook: C and D on string 2, then E, F and G on string 1, and back to D.
rows.translation: Grípandi stefið: C og D á streng 2, svo E, F og G á streng 1 og aftur á D.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 2 · lesson gtr-2-spotlight “Song spotlight: Letters in a Shoebox” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Press with your fingertips, arched like a bridge, so no finger leans on the string below it. Short nails make this much easier.
rows.translation: Þrýstu með fingurgómunum og sveigðu fingurna eins og brú, svo enginn þeirra snerti strenginn fyrir neðan. Stuttar neglur auðvelda þetta mikið.

rows.source: Pick the strings one at a time, thick to thin. A dull thud means a finger is touching that string. Adjust and pick it again.
rows.translation: Plokkaðu einn streng í einu, frá þykkum að þunnum. Dauft högg merkir að fingur snertir strenginn. Lagaðu gripið og plokkaðu aftur.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-1 “Clean chords” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: One string sounds dull. What's the likely cause?
rows.translation: Einn strengur hljómar dauft. Hver er líklegasta orsökin?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-1 “Clean chords” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-1 “Clean chords” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Þú slóst of hægt yfir strengina

Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-1 “Clean chords” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: A fingertip leaning on a neighboring string stops it ringing. Arch your fingers more.
rows.translation: Fingurgómur sem hallar að næsta streng hindrar hann í að óma. Sveigðu fingurna meira.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-1 “Clean chords” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Keep your E minor shape and add your first finger on string 3, fret 1. That one note turns minor into major.
rows.translation: Haltu E-moll gripinu og bættu fyrsta fingri á streng 3 við band 1. Þessi eini tónn breytir moll í dúr.

rows.source: Major chords tend to sound bright and settled. Minor chords sound darker. E and E minor differ by just one note.
rows.translation: Dúrhljómar hljóma oft bjartir og stöðugir. Mollhljómar eru dekkri. Aðeins einn tónn er ólíkur í E og E-moll.

rows.source: A minor is the E shape moved one string thinner: fingers 2 and 3 on fret 2, finger 1 on string 2, fret 1.
rows.translation: A-moll er E-gripið fært á næstu þynnri strengi: fingur 2 og 3 á bandi 2, fingur 1 á streng 2 við band 1.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-3 “A minor” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: The root is the note a chord is named after. In A minor it's open string 5, so start your strum there and skip string 6.
rows.translation: Grunntónninn er tónninn sem hljómurinn heitir eftir. Í A-moll er það opinn strengur 5. Byrjaðu yfirsláttinn þar og slepptu streng 6.

rows.source: A minor's root is open string 5. Start the strum there.
rows.translation: Grunntónn A-moll er opinn strengur 5. Byrjaðu yfirsláttinn þar.

rows.source: A packs fingers 1, 2 and 3 side by side on fret 2, on strings 4, 3 and 2. Strum from string 5.
rows.translation: Í A eru fingur 1, 2 og 3 hlið við hlið á bandi 2, á strengjum 4, 3 og 2. Sláðu yfir frá streng 5.

rows.source: If your fingers feel cramped, slant them so each sits just behind the fret at a slight angle. Keep string 1 clear so it rings.
rows.translation: Ef þröngt er um fingurna skaltu halla þeim lítillega svo hver þeirra sitji rétt aftan við bandið. Hafðu streng 1 lausan svo hann ómi.

rows.source: Which fret holds all three fingers in A?
rows.translation: Á hvaða bandi eru allir þrír fingurnir í A?

rows.source: From E minor to A minor, fingers 2 and 3 hop together to strings 4 and 3. Then finger 1 lands on string 2. Your hand barely moves.
rows.translation: Úr E-moll í A-moll hoppa fingur 2 og 3 saman yfir á strengi 4 og 3. Svo lendir fingur 1 á streng 2. Höndin hreyfist varla.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-5 “From E minor to A minor” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Skiptu snemma, lentu á fyrsta slagi
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-5 “From E minor to A minor” · step 4 (explain) · title

rows.source: Strum once, then use the rest of the bar to change. Aim to land the new chord right on beat one. Speed comes later, by itself.
rows.translation: Sláðu einu sinni yfir og notaðu svo restina af taktinum til að skipta. Reyndu að lenda á nýja hljómnum á fyrsta slagi. Hraðinn kemur af sjálfu sér síðar.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-5 “From E minor to A minor” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: How should your fingers travel between chords?
rows.translation: Hvernig eiga fingurnir að færast milli hljóma?

rows.source: Moving the fingers as a unit is faster and lands cleaner. Keep them low, just above the strings.
rows.translation: Það er fljótlegra og hreinlegra að færa fingurna sem eina heild. Hafðu þá lágt, rétt yfir strengjunum.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-5 “From E minor to A minor” · step 7 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Every finger moves from A to E. Picture the E shape before you lift, then move all three together. Aim finger 2 at string 5.
rows.translation: Allir fingurnir færast úr A í E. Sjáðu E-gripið fyrir þér áður en þú lyftir og færðu svo alla þrjá saman. Miðaðu fingri 2 á streng 5.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-6 “From A to E” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Song spotlight: Dust on the Dashboard
rows.translation: Lag í sviðsljósinu: Ryk á mælaborðinu
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-spotlight “Song spotlight: Dust on the Dashboard” · title
Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-spotlight “Song spotlight: Dust on the Dashboard” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Dust on the Dashboard is a Timbre Original: country in A. Every verse ends on two bars of E and two of A, the change you just learned. See the shape, move early and land on beat one. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
rows.translation: Ryk á mælaborðinu er frumsamið lag frá Timbre: kántrí í A. Hvert erindi endar á tveimur töktum af E og tveimur af A, skiptunum sem þú varst að læra. Sjáðu gripið, færðu snemma og lentu á fyrsta slagi. Allt lagið er á flipanum Lög, undir Frumsamin lög.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-spotlight “Song spotlight: Dust on the Dashboard” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Over E: open B, open E, D at fret 3 on string 2, C sharp at fret 2, then G sharp at fret 1 on string 3.
rows.translation: Yfir E: opið B, opið E, D á bandi 3 á streng 2, hækkað C á bandi 2, svo hækkað G á bandi 1 á streng 3.

rows.translation: Ekkert nýtt: E-moll, E, A-moll og A. Láttu hvert grip hljóma hreint og haltu síðan jöfnum hljómaskiptum.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · challenge gtr-3-7 “Chord-change challenge” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Fingur 1 á streng 3 við band 1 gefur eina tóninn sem gerir E-dúr.

rows.translation: Niðurstrik, áttundapartar niður og upp, áherslur og sláttarhönd sem stoppar aldrei.

rows.source: A quarter note lasts one beat. Strum down on every beat and count out loud: one, two, three, four.
rows.translation: Fjórðapartsnóta varir í eitt slag. Sláðu niður á hverju slagi og teldu upphátt: einn, tveir, þrír, fjórir.

rows.source: Let the motion come from a loose wrist and forearm, like shaking water off your hand. A stiff arm sounds harsh.
rows.translation: Láttu hreyfinguna koma úr lausum úlnlið og framhandlegg, eins og þú hristir vatn af hendinni. Stífur handleggur gefur hvassan hljóm.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 4 · lesson gtr-4-1 “One strum per beat” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: How many quarter-note strums fill a bar of four?
rows.translation: Hve margir fjórðaparts-yfirslættir fylla fjögurra slaga takt?

rows.source: Split each beat in two. Strum down on the number and up on the and: one and two and. That's eight strums per bar.
rows.translation: Skiptu hverju slagi í tvennt. Sláðu niður á tölunni og upp á og: einn og tveir og. Það eru átta yfirslættir í takti.

rows.source: Down on the number, up on the and. Your hand goes down and up once per beat.
rows.translation: Niður á tölunni, upp á og. Höndin fer niður og upp einu sinni á hverju slagi.

rows.source: Up strums are naturally softer. Brush just the thinner three or four strings on the way up. That gives the groove its lift.
rows.translation: Yfirslættir upp eru eðlilega veikari. Renndu aðeins yfir þrjá eða fjóra þynnstu strengina á leiðinni upp. Það gefur hrynjandinni léttleika.

rows.source: An accent is a note played a little louder. Strum beat one harder than the rest. It tells everyone where the bar begins.
rows.translation: Áhersla er tónn sem er spilaður aðeins sterkar. Sláðu fastar á fyrsta slagi en hinum. Það segir öllum hvar takturinn byrjar.

rows.source: Beat one starts the bar. A slightly louder first strum keeps you, and anyone listening, in time.
rows.translation: Fyrsta slagið byrjar taktinn. Örlítið sterkari fyrsti yfirsláttur heldur bæði þér og þeim sem hlusta í takti.

rows.source: Say the bar number on beat one: one, two, three, four; two, two, three, four. You always know where you are.
rows.translation: Segðu númer taktsins á fyrsta slagi: einn, tveir, þrír, fjórir; tveir, tveir, þrír, fjórir. Þá veistu alltaf hvar þú ert.

rows.source: Your strumming hand swings down and up all the time, like a pendulum. To skip a strum, keep swinging and simply miss the strings.
rows.translation: Sláttarhöndin sveiflast stöðugt niður og upp, eins og pendúll. Til að sleppa yfirslætti heldurðu sveiflunni áfram en ferð fram hjá strengjunum.

rows.source: To skip a strum, your hand…
rows.translation: Til að sleppa yfirslætti, hvað gerir höndin?

rows.source: A hand that never stops keeps steady time. The skipped strum is a swing that doesn't touch the strings.
rows.translation: Hönd sem stoppar aldrei heldur jöfnum takti. Yfirslætti er sleppt með sveiflu sem snertir ekki strengina.

rows.source: This pattern drives countless songs. On beat three your hand swings down without touching the strings, then catches the up strum.
rows.translation: Þetta mynstur knýr ótal lög áfram. Á þriðja slagi sveiflast höndin niður án þess að snerta strengina og slær svo upp yfir þá.

rows.translation: Í þessu mynstri, á hvaða slagi er enginn yfirsláttur á tölunni?

rows.source: Low Tide Radio is a Timbre Original: laid-back reggae on E minor and A. The guitar plays only the ands. Keep your hand swinging down and up, miss the strings on each number and catch every and. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
rows.translation: Fjöruútvarp er frumsamið lag frá Timbre: afslappað reggí með E-moll og A. Gítarinn spilar aðeins á og. Sveiflaðu hendinni niður og upp, farðu fram hjá strengjunum á hverri tölu og sláðu á hvert og. Allt lagið er á flipanum Lög, undir Frumsamin lög.

rows.source: Where does the guitar play in Low Tide Radio?

rows.source: This English tune is over 400 years old. Its chords are all ones you know: A minor, C, G, E minor, F and E. It's in three: strum once per bar, then on every beat.
rows.translation: Þetta enska lag er yfir 400 ára gamalt. Þú kannt alla hljómana: A-moll, C, G, E-moll, F og E. Það er í þrískiptum takti: sláðu einu sinni í takti, svo á hverju slagi.

rows.source: A sharp raises a note by one fret. Greensleeves uses G sharp on string 3, fret 1, and F sharp on string 4, fret 4. Reach that one with your little finger.
rows.translation: Kross hækkar tón um eitt band. Greensleeves notar hækkað G á streng 3 við band 1 og hækkað F á streng 4 við band 4. Náðu þeim síðari með litlafingri.

rows.source: G sharp, A, B: string 3 at frets 1 and 2, then open string 2.
rows.translation: Hækkað G, A, B: strengur 3 á böndum 1 og 2, svo opinn strengur 2.

rows.translation: Kross merkir einu bandi hærra. Hækkað G liggur milli G og A.

rows.source: The chorus starts high: G on string 1, fret 3, then F sharp at fret 2.
rows.translation: Viðlagið byrjar hátt: G á streng 1 við band 3, svo hækkað F á bandi 2.

rows.source: A seventh chord adds a note that pulls toward home. D7 wants to move to G. Fingers: 2 on string 3, fret 2; 1 on string 2, fret 1; 3 on string 1, fret 2.
rows.translation: Sjöundarhljómur bætir við tóni sem togar heim á leið. D7 vill færast í G. Fingur: 2 á streng 3 við band 2; 1 á streng 2 við band 1; 3 á streng 1 við band 2.

rows.source: This American ballad from the 1880s needs only G and D7. It's in three, like Amazing Grace. Strum once per bar, then on every beat.
rows.translation: Þessi bandaríska ballada frá 1880-árunum þarf aðeins G og D7. Hún er í þrískiptum takti, eins og Amazing Grace. Sláðu einu sinni í takti, svo á hverju slagi.

rows.source: Clementine's melody sits on strings 4, 3 and 2. Its last line uses F sharp again: string 4, fret 4, little finger.
rows.translation: Laglínan í Clementine liggur á strengjum 4, 3 og 2. Síðasta línan notar aftur hækkað F: strengur 4, band 4, litlifingur.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 7 · song gtr-7-5 “Clementine” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: The opening: G G G, down to open D, up to open B.
rows.translation: Upphafið: G G G, niður á opið D, upp á opið B.

rows.source: D7's extra note leans toward G. When G arrives, the tension lets go.
rows.translation: Viðbótartónninn í D7 leitar að G. Þegar G kemur leysist spennan.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 7 · song gtr-7-5 “Clementine” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: The last line: A, open D, F sharp at fret 4, A, then home to G.
rows.translation: Síðasta línan: A, opið D, hækkað F á bandi 4, A og svo heim á G.

rows.source: Ghost Light is a Timbre Original: a slow, dark ballad. Its verse walks A minor, F, C and E, so your mini F gets a song, and the G sharp in E pulls the tune back home. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
rows.translation: Draugaljós er frumsamið lag frá Timbre: hæg, dimm ballada. Erindið fer um A-moll, F, C og E, svo litla F-gripið fær lag og hækkað G í E togar laglínuna aftur heim. Allt lagið er á flipanum Lög, undir Frumsamin lög.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 7 · lesson gtr-7-spotlight “Song spotlight: Ghost Light” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Listen to the verse's last chord. Major or minor?
rows.translation: Hlustaðu á síðasta hljóm erindisins. Dúr eða moll?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 7 · lesson gtr-7-spotlight “Song spotlight: Ghost Light” · step 3 (listen) · question or instruction
Guitar · Unit 7 · lesson gtr-7-spotlight “Song spotlight: Ghost Light” · step 4 (explain) · title

rows.source: The ballad strum: one big strum on beat one and let it ring, another on three, then down-up on four. The space after each strum is part of the song.
rows.translation: Ballöðuyfirsláttur: einn sterkur yfirsláttur á fyrsta slagi sem fær að óma, annar á þriðja og svo niður-upp á fjórða. Bilið eftir hvern yfirslátt er hluti af laginu.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 7 · lesson gtr-7-spotlight “Song spotlight: Ghost Light” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: The verse's last line: open B, C at fret 1, B, G sharp at fret 1 on string 3, B, then open E.
rows.translation: Síðasta lína erindisins: opið B, C á bandi 1, B, hækkað G á bandi 1 á streng 3, B, svo opið E.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 7 · lesson gtr-7-spotlight “Song spotlight: Ghost Light” · step 6 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: No new ideas: the mini F, D7 and both songs from this unit. Change chords early and let the melodies sing.
rows.translation: Ekkert nýtt: litla F-gripið, D7 og bæði lög þessarar einingar. Skiptu snemma um hljóma og láttu laglínurnar syngja.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 7 · challenge gtr-7-6 “Songbook challenge” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Play E, then lift finger 3 off string 4. The open D that rings is the seventh, a note that adds bluesy tension.
rows.translation: Spilaðu E og lyftu svo fingri 3 af streng 4. Opna D sem ómar er sjöundin, tónn sem bætir við blúskenndri spennu.

rows.translation: Spilaðu A og lyftu svo fingri 2 af streng 3. Opið G ómar og A verður A7.

rows.source: G7 keeps the low G but puts F on top: finger 3 on string 6, fret 3; finger 2 on string 5, fret 2; finger 1 on string 1, fret 1.
rows.translation: G7 heldur lága G en setur F efst: fingur 3 á streng 6 við band 3; fingur 2 á streng 5 við band 2; fingur 1 á streng 1 við band 1.

rows.source: Build B7 from string 5: finger 2 at fret 2, finger 1 on string 4, fret 1, finger 3 on string 3, fret 2, little finger on string 1, fret 2. String 2 rings open.
rows.translation: Byggðu B7 frá streng 5: fingur 2 við band 2, fingur 1 á streng 4 við band 1, fingur 3 á streng 3 við band 2, litlifingur á streng 1 við band 2. Strengur 2 ómar opinn.

rows.source: B7 pulls toward E. Its tension melts into E minor or E.
rows.translation: B7 togar að E. Spennan bráðnar yfir í E-moll eða E.

rows.source: A shuffle splits each beat unevenly: a long strum down, a short one up. It's the heartbeat of the blues. Think hum-pty, dum-pty.
rows.translation: Shuffle skiptir hverju slagi ójafnt: langur yfirsláttur niður, stuttur upp. Það er hjartsláttur blússins. Hugsaðu dúm-da, dúm-da.

rows.source: Many blues songs follow one 12-bar plan. In E: four bars of E7, two of A7, two of E7, then one each of B7, A7, E7 and B7.
rows.translation: Mörg blúslög fylgja einni 12 takta uppbyggingu. Í E: fjórir taktar af E7, tveir af A7, tveir af E7 og svo einn af hverjum: B7, A7, E7 og B7.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 8 · lesson gtr-8-4 “12-bar blues in E” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: How many bars of E7 open the 12-bar blues?
rows.translation: Hve margir taktar af E7 hefja 12 takta blúsinn?

rows.source: The last four bars move faster: B7, A7, E7, then B7, which turns you around to the top. Change early and keep the shuffle going.
rows.translation: Síðustu fjórir taktarnir skipta hraðar: B7, A7, E7 og svo B7, sem snýr þér aftur að upphafinu. Skiptu snemma og haltu shuffle-hrynjandinni gangandi.

rows.source: A sus chord swaps the note that makes it major or minor for a neighbor. It sounds open and unresolved until it settles home.
rows.translation: Sus-hljómur skiptir tóninum sem gerir hann að dúr eða moll út fyrir nágrannatón. Hann hljómar opinn og óleystur þar til hann sest heim.

rows.source: Lift finger 2 off string 1 to get Dsus2. For Asus4, play A and add your little finger on string 2, fret 3.
rows.translation: Lyftu fingri 2 af streng 1 til að fá Dsus2. Fyrir Asus4 spilarðu A og bætir litlafingri á streng 2 við band 3.

rows.source: Rust Belt Shuffle is a Timbre Original: a 12-bar blues in E, the plan you just strummed, with a swung tune on top. Keep the long-short feel in both hands. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
rows.translation: Ryðbeltissveifla er frumsamið lag frá Timbre: 12 takta blús í E, uppbyggingin sem þú slóst rétt áðan, með sveiflandi laglínu yfir. Haltu löngu-stuttu hrynjandinni í báðum höndum. Allt lagið er á flipanum Lög, undir Frumsamin lög.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 8 · lesson gtr-8-spotlight “Song spotlight: Rust Belt Shuffle” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Open G, then G sharp at fret 1 on string 3, then open B: the bluesy slide in bar two.
rows.translation: Opið G, svo hækkað G á bandi 1 á streng 3, svo opið B: blúskennda rennslan í öðrum takti.

rows.source: Bar two slides from G to G sharp. Which one belongs to E7?

rows.source: E7 is E, G sharp, B and D. G is the blue note: it rubs against the chord, then slides into it.
rows.translation: E7 er E, hækkað G, B og D. G er blústónninn: hann rekst á hljóminn og rennur svo inn í hann.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 8 · lesson gtr-8-spotlight “Song spotlight: Rust Belt Shuffle” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Níundi taktur, yfir B7: hækkað F á bandi 2 á streng 1, opið E, hækkað D á bandi 4 á streng 2 með litlafingri, svo B.

rows.source: A power chord plays only the root and the fifth, the note five letters up. Neither major nor minor, it stays punchy, even loud. E5 is the bottom of E minor.
rows.translation: Kraftahljómur notar aðeins grunntón og fimmund, tóninn fimm bókstöfum ofar. Hann er hvorki dúr né moll og heldur kraftinum, jafnvel hátt spilaður. E5 er neðsti hluti E-moll.

rows.source: Move the same two fingers to strings 4 and 3. With open string 5, that's A5. Aim your strum at strings 5, 4 and 3 only.

rows.source: Rock often builds with muted eighths, then lands on an open chord. Lift your palm for the big strum and let it ring.

rows.source: The same shape works from string 5. Finger 1 on string 5, fret 3 gives C5. Let the tip of finger 1 touch string 6 to keep it quiet.
rows.translation: Sama grip virkar frá streng 5. Fingur 1 á streng 5 við band 3 gefur C5. Láttu góminn á fingri 1 snerta streng 6 til að halda honum þöglum.

rows.translation: Riff er stutt, grípandi hending sem endurtekur sig. Þetta riff skoppar út frá opnu lágu E. Láttu lófann hvíla við brúna til að halda því þéttu.

rows.source: Open E, string 6 at fret 3, then open A.

rows.source: Songs often answer a riff with power chords. Play the riff, then hit the chords on one, the and of two, and four.
rows.translation: Lög svara oft riffi með kraftahljómum. Spilaðu riffið og sláðu svo hljómana á fyrsta slagi, á og eftir annað slag og á fjórða slagi.

rows.source: Two frets above G is A. The chord's name moves with its root.

rows.source: Basement Weather is a Timbre Original: garage rock in A. A riff on the low strings opens it, then power chords punch back on one, the and of two, and four. Keep your palm at the bridge. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
rows.translation: Kjallaraveður er frumsamið lag frá Timbre: bílskúrsrokk í A. Riff á lágu strengjunum byrjar lagið, svo svara kraftahljómar á fyrsta slagi, á og eftir annað slag og á fjórða slagi. Hafðu lófann við brúna. Allt lagið er á flipanum Lög, undir Frumsamin lög.

rows.source: Open A, C at fret 3 on string 5, open D, then G at fret 3 on string 6 and open low E.
rows.translation: Opið A, C á bandi 3 á streng 5, opið D, svo G á bandi 3 á streng 6 og opið lágt E.

rows.source: You know C5, with finger 1 on string 5, fret 3. Slide the whole shape up two frets and it becomes D5. G5 sits at fret 3 too, one string lower than C5.
rows.translation: Þú kannt C5, með fingur 1 á streng 5 við band 3. Renndu öllu gripinu upp um tvö bönd og það verður D5. G5 er líka við band 3, einum streng neðar en C5.

rows.source: Full barre chords take weeks, so build up to them. You know the mini F. Next comes a five-string F, then the full barre.
rows.translation: Heil barrégrip taka margar vikur að læra, svo byggðu þau upp í skrefum. Þú kannt litla F-gripið. Næst kemur F á fimm strengjum og svo heilt barrégrip.

rows.source: Move finger 3 to string 5, fret 3, and put your little finger on string 4, fret 3. Five strings ring and the F sounds fuller.
rows.translation: Færðu fingur 3 á streng 5 við band 3 og settu litlafingur á streng 4 við band 3. Fimm strengir óma og F hljómar fyllra.

rows.source: Strength and feel build slowly. Short, daily practice beats one long, painful session.

rows.source: Lay finger 1 flat across all six strings at fret 1. Fingers 2, 3 and 4 make an E shape in front of it. F is E moved up one fret.
rows.translation: Leggðu fingur 1 flatan yfir alla sex strengina við band 1. Fingur 2, 3 og 4 mynda E-grip framan við hann. F er E fært upp um eitt band.

rows.source: Let your arm's weight pull the barre in, as if gently drawing the neck toward you. Your thumb only steadies. Roll finger 1 onto its side.
rows.translation: Láttu þunga handleggsins toga barrégripið inn, eins og þú dragir hálsinn varlega að þér. Þumallinn heldur aðeins stöðugleika. Veltu fingri 1 á hliðina.

rows.translation: Er barré enn of erfitt? Spilaðu aðeins á fjóra efstu strengina: band 4 á strengjum 4 og 3, band 3 á streng 2 og band 2 á streng 1.

rows.source: The minor pentatonic scale has five notes. In A minor they're A, C, D, E and G. It's the sound of countless blues and rock solos.
rows.translation: Fimmtóna molltónstigi hefur fimm tóna. Í A-moll eru það A, C, D, E og G. Þetta er hljómurinn í ótal blús- og rokksólóum.

rows.source: p thumb, i index, m middle, a ring. The little finger usually rests.
rows.translation: p þumall, i vísifingur, m langatöng, a baugfingur. Litlifingurinn hvílir yfirleitt.

rows.source: Each finger plucks up and slightly toward your palm, then relaxes. Keep your hand still above the strings and let the fingers do the moving.
rows.translation: Hver fingur plokkar upp og örlítið inn að lófanum og slakar svo á. Haltu hendinni kyrrri yfir strengjunum og láttu fingurna sjá um hreyfinguna.

rows.source: Travis picking, named after Merle Travis, keeps the thumb alternating on every beat while the fingers pluck in between, on the ands.
rows.translation: Travis-fingraspil, kennt við Merle Travis, lætur þumalinn víxla á hverju slagi á meðan fingurnir plokka á milli, á og-slögunum.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 11 · lesson gtr-11-3 “Travis picking” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Alternates bass notes on every beat
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 11 · lesson gtr-11-3 “Travis picking” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: The thumb is the steady pulse: a bass note on every beat, rocking between two strings.
rows.translation: Þumallinn er jafn púlsinn: bassatónn á hverju slagi, til skiptis á tveimur strengjum.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 11 · lesson gtr-11-3 “Travis picking” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Keep the thumb going. Between thumb notes, m plucks string 2 and i plucks string 3: thumb, m, thumb, i. Go slowly until it runs by itself.
rows.translation: Haltu þumlinum gangandi. Milli þumaltóna plokkar m streng 2 og i streng 3: þumall, m, þumall, i. Farðu hægt þar til þetta gerist af sjálfu sér.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 11 · lesson gtr-11-3 “Travis picking” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text
Guitar · Unit 11 · lesson gtr-11-3 “Travis picking” · step 5 (along) · title

rows.source: Between thumb notes, which finger plucks string 2?
rows.translation: Hvaða fingur plokkar streng 2 milli þumaltóna?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 11 · lesson gtr-11-3 “Travis picking” · step 6 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: In this pattern m takes string 2 and i takes string 3. The a finger rests for now.
rows.translation: Í þessu mynstri tekur m streng 2 og i streng 3. Fingurinn a hvílir í bili.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 11 · lesson gtr-11-3 “Travis picking” · step 6 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: When the chord changes, the thumb lands on the new root right on beat one. The fingers keep plucking strings 2 and 3 as before.
rows.translation: Þegar hljómurinn breytist lendir þumallinn á nýja grunntóninum nákvæmlega á fyrsta slagi. Fingurnir halda áfram að plokka strengi 2 og 3 eins og áður.

rows.source: The bass tells the ear which chord you're on. Landing the root on beat one makes the change clear.
rows.translation: Bassinn segir eyranu á hvaða hljómi þú ert. Að lenda á grunntóninum á fyrsta slagi gerir skiptin skýr.

rows.source: Hold each chord for the whole bar so every note rings into the next. Lift a finger only when the next shape needs it.
rows.translation: Haltu hverjum hljómi allan taktinn svo hver tónn ómi inn í þann næsta. Lyftu fingri aðeins þegar næsta grip krefst þess.

rows.source: An arpeggio plays a chord one note at a time. This one rolls p, i, m, a, then back down m, i. Six notes fill a bar of three, two to a beat.
rows.translation: Hljómbrot spilar hljóm einn tón í einu. Hér rennur það p, i, m, a, svo aftur niður m, i. Sex tónar fylla þrískiptan takt, tveir á hvert slag.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 11 · lesson gtr-11-5 “A fingerpicked ballad” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: After a plucks string 1, which finger comes next?
rows.translation: Hvaða fingur kemur á eftir a sem plokkar streng 1?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 11 · lesson gtr-11-5 “A fingerpicked ballad” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: The roll turns around at the top: p, i, m, a, then m and i on the way back.
rows.translation: Röðin snýr við efst: p, i, m, a, svo m og i á leiðinni til baka.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 11 · lesson gtr-11-5 “A fingerpicked ballad” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: One bar each: A minor, F, C, G, then A minor, F, E, A minor. Your thumb finds each new root: strings 5, 4, 5 and 6.
rows.translation: Einn taktur af hverjum: A-moll, F, C, G, svo A-moll, F, E, A-moll. Þumallinn finnur hvern nýjan grunntón: strengi 5, 4, 5 og 6.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 11 · lesson gtr-11-5 “A fingerpicked ballad” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Porchlight is a Timbre Original: a slow ballad in D. Fingerpick it: your thumb on each chord's root, then i, m and a up strings 3, 2 and 1. Let every note ring into the next. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
rows.translation: Verandarljós er frumsamið lag frá Timbre: hæg ballada í D. Plokkaðu það: þumallinn á grunntón hvers hljóms, svo i, m og a upp strengi 3, 2 og 1. Láttu hvern tón óma inn í þann næsta. Allt lagið er á flipanum Lög, undir Frumsamin lög.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 11 · lesson gtr-11-spotlight “Song spotlight: Porchlight” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: In D, which string does your thumb play?
rows.translation: Hvaða streng spilar þumallinn í D?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 11 · lesson gtr-11-spotlight “Song spotlight: Porchlight” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: D's root is open string 4. Strings 5 and 6 stay quiet in this chord.
rows.translation: Grunntónn D er opinn strengur 4. Strengir 5 og 6 þegja í þessum hljómi.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 11 · lesson gtr-11-spotlight “Song spotlight: Porchlight” · step 2 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: No new ideas: the alternating bass, p-i-m-a, Travis picking and the ballad. Keep the thumb steady and let every note ring.
rows.translation: Ekkert nýtt: víxlbassinn, p-i-m-a, Travis-fingraspil og balladan. Haltu þumlinum jöfnum og láttu hvern tón óma.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 11 · challenge gtr-11-6 “Fingerpicking challenge” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Hvaða bókstafur táknar þumalinn í p-i-m-a?

rows.source: The 12-bar in A, the quick change, a boogie bass line, the turnaround and your first blues licks.
rows.translation: 12 takta blús í A, fljót skipti, boogie-bassalína, viðsnúningur og fyrstu blússtefin þín.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 12 “Blues” · unit summary
Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-1 “The blues in A” · title
Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-1 “The blues in A” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Blues chords sit on the first, fourth and fifth notes of the key. In E that's E7, A7 and B7. Move to the key of A and they become A7, D7 and E7.
rows.translation: Blúshljómar byggja á fyrsta, fjórða og fimmta tóni tóntegundarinnar. Í E eru það E7, A7 og B7. Færðu í tóntegundina A og þeir verða A7, D7 og E7.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-1 “The blues in A” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: In the key of A, which chord does the job B7 did in E?
rows.translation: Í tóntegundinni A, hvaða hljómur tekur við hlutverki B7 í E?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-1 “The blues in A” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: B7 is five letters up from E. Five letters up from A is E, so E7 takes its place.
rows.translation: B7 er fimm bókstöfum ofar en E. Fimm bókstöfum ofar en A er E, svo E7 tekur við.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-1 “The blues in A” · step 2 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-1 “The blues in A” · step 4 (explain) · title

rows.source: Four bars of A7, two of D7, two of A7, then one each of E7, D7, A7 and E7. The last E7 turns you back to the top.
rows.translation: Fjórir taktar af A7, tveir af D7, tveir af A7 og svo einn af hverjum: E7, D7, A7 og E7. Síðasta E7 snýr þér aftur að upphafinu.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-1 “The blues in A” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text
Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-2 “The quick change” · title
Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-2 “The quick change” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: In a quick change, bar 2 jumps to the four chord and straight back. In A: A7, D7, A7, A7. It adds motion right from the start.
rows.translation: Í fljótum skiptum hoppar taktur 2 á fjórða hljóminn og beint til baka. Í A: A7, D7, A7, A7. Það gefur hreyfingu strax í upphafi.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-2 “The quick change” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: In a quick change in A, which chord is bar 2?
rows.translation: Í fljótum skiptum í A, hvaða hljómur er í takti 2?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-2 “The quick change” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: The four chord in A is D7. The quick change visits it in bar 2, then returns to A7.
rows.translation: Fjórði hljómurinn í A er D7. Fljótu skiptin heimsækja hann í takti 2 og snúa svo aftur í A7.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-2 “The quick change” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-2 “The quick change” · step 5 (explain) · title

rows.source: The quick change works in any key. In E: E7, A7, E7, E7. Watch for B7 near the end, your four-finger chord.
rows.translation: Fljótu skiptin virka í öllum tóntegundum. Í E: E7, A7, E7, E7. Fylgstu með B7 undir lokin, fjögurra fingra hljómnum þínum.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-2 “The quick change” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text

Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-3 “A boogie bass line” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: A boogie line walks up the chord and back, each note twice, long-short like the shuffle. Over A7 it climbs A, C sharp, E, F sharp, G, then walks back down.
rows.translation: Boogie-lína gengur upp hljóminn og til baka, hver tónn tvisvar, langt-stutt eins og shuffle. Yfir A7 klifrar hún A, hækkað C, E, hækkað F, G og gengur svo aftur niður.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-3 “A boogie bass line” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Open A, fret 4 on string 5, frets 2 and 4 on string 4, then open G.
rows.translation: Opið A, band 4 á streng 5, bönd 2 og 4 á streng 4, svo opið G.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-3 “A boogie bass line” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-3 “A boogie bass line” · step 3 (along) · title

rows.source: How do the two notes of each pair feel?
rows.translation: Hvernig er hrynjandi tónanna tveggja í hverju pari?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-3 “A boogie bass line” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-3 “A boogie bass line” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: It's the shuffle again: a long note on the beat, a short one just before the next.
rows.translation: Það er aftur shuffle: langur tónn á slaginu, stuttur rétt fyrir næsta slag.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-3 “A boogie bass line” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Move it to D and E
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-3 “A boogie bass line” · step 5 (explain) · title

rows.source: The same walk starts from D on string 4 and from E on string 6. Over D7: D, F sharp, A, B, C. Over E7: E, G sharp, B, C sharp, D.
rows.translation: Sama ganga byrjar á D á streng 4 og E á streng 6. Yfir D7: D, hækkað F, A, B, C. Yfir E7: E, hækkað G, B, hækkað C, D.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-3 “A boogie bass line” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text

Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-3 “A boogie bass line” · step 7 (along) · title

rows.source: Boogie, A to D and back
rows.translation: Boogie, frá A í D og til baka
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-3 “A boogie bass line” · step 8 (along) · title

rows.source: A lick that turns you around
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-4 “The turnaround” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Bars 11 and 12 often get a turnaround, a short lick that leads back to the top. This one walks down from A to E, one fret at a time.
rows.translation: Taktar 11 og 12 fá oft viðsnúning, stutt stef sem leiðir aftur að upphafinu. Þetta gengur niður frá A til E, eitt band í einu.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-4 “The turnaround” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-4 “The turnaround” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: String 4: fret 4, then 3, then 2. Let the E ring.
rows.translation: Strengur 4: band 4, svo 3, svo 2. Láttu E óma.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-4 “The turnaround” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Where does a turnaround usually go?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-4 “The turnaround” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-4 “The turnaround” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-4 “The turnaround” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-4 “The turnaround” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: The last two bars. It leads the ear back to bar 1 for another time around.
rows.translation: Í síðustu tveimur töktunum. Hann leiðir eyrað aftur að takti 1 fyrir aðra umferð.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-4 “The turnaround” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-4 “The turnaround” · step 6 (explain) · title

rows.source: Strum the first ten bars with the quick change, then switch to the lick for bars 11 and 12. That's how a blues band ends each time around.
rows.translation: Sláðu yfir fyrstu tíu taktana með fljótu skiptunum og skiptu svo í stefið í töktum 11 og 12. Þannig endar blúshljómsveit hverja umferð.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-4 “The turnaround” · step 6 (explain) · lesson card text

Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-5 “Blues licks in A” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Your A minor pentatonic box fits right over a blues in A. Its C rubs against the C sharp in A7, and that rub is the sound of the blues.
rows.translation: A-moll fimmtóna mynstrið þitt passar beint yfir blús í A. C þess rekst á hækkað C í A7 og þessi núningur er hljómur blússins.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-5 “Blues licks in A” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-5 “Blues licks in A” · step 3 (along) · title

rows.source: Over a blues in A, which note sounds most like home?
rows.translation: Yfir blús í A, hvaða tónn hljómar mest eins og heimili?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-5 “Blues licks in A” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: A is the root of the key. Licks that end on A sound settled; G and C leave you hanging.
rows.translation: A er grunntónn tóntegundarinnar. Stef sem enda á A hljóma stöðug; G og C skilja þig eftir í lausu lofti.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-5 “Blues licks in A” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-5 “Blues licks in A” · step 5 (along) · title
Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-5 “Blues licks in A” · step 6 (explain) · title

rows.source: Blues phrases talk to each other. Play lick 1 as the question, then answer with lick 2, which lands on the low A.
rows.translation: Blúshendingar tala saman. Spilaðu stef 1 sem spurningu og svaraðu svo með stefi 2, sem lendir á lága A.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-5 “Blues licks in A” · step 6 (explain) · lesson card text

Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-spotlight “Song spotlight: Neon Laundromat” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Neon Laundromat is a Timbre Original: funk that sits on one chord, A7. Its hook slides from C to C sharp, the same rub your blues licks make, and its chorus drops to E7. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
rows.translation: Neonþvottahús er frumsamið lag frá Timbre: fönk á einum hljómi, A7. Grípandi stefið rennur úr C í hækkað C, sami núningur og í blússtefunum þínum, og viðlagið fer niður í E7. Allt lagið er á flipanum Lög, undir Frumsamin lög.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-spotlight “Song spotlight: Neon Laundromat” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: A at fret 2 on string 3, then C and C sharp at frets 1 and 2 on string 2, then open E.
rows.translation: A á bandi 2 á streng 3, svo C og hækkað C á böndum 1 og 2 á streng 2, svo opið E.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-spotlight “Song spotlight: Neon Laundromat” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Over A7, which note rubs against the chord?
rows.translation: Yfir A7, hvaða tónn rekst á hljóminn?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-spotlight “Song spotlight: Neon Laundromat” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-spotlight “Song spotlight: Neon Laundromat” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: A7 is A, C sharp, E and G. C, from your pentatonic box, rubs against its C sharp, and the hook slides from one to the other.
rows.translation: A7 er A, hækkað C, E og G. C úr fimmtóna mynstrinu rekst á hækkaða C hljómsins og grípandi stefið rennur á milli þeirra.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-spotlight “Song spotlight: Neon Laundromat” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-spotlight “Song spotlight: Neon Laundromat” · step 5 (explain) · title

rows.source: Neon Laundromat doesn't shuffle. Play your boogie walk in even eighths and it becomes a bass line under the A7: A, C sharp, E, F sharp, G, and back down.
rows.translation: Neonþvottahús notar ekki shuffle. Spilaðu boogie-gönguna í jöfnum áttundapörtum og hún verður bassalína undir A7: A, hækkað C, E, hækkað F, G og aftur niður.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-spotlight “Song spotlight: Neon Laundromat” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text
Guitar · Unit 12 · challenge gtr-12-6 “Blues challenge” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: No new ideas: the 12-bar in A and E, the quick change, the boogie line, the turnaround and your licks. Keep the shuffle swinging.
rows.translation: Ekkert nýtt: 12 takta blús í A og E, fljótu skiptin, boogie-línan, viðsnúningurinn og stefin þín. Haltu shuffle-sveiflunni gangandi.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · challenge gtr-12-6 “Blues challenge” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: In a quick change in E, which chord is bar 2?
rows.translation: Í fljótum skiptum í E, hvaða hljómur er í takti 2?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · challenge gtr-12-6 “Blues challenge” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction
Guitar · Unit 12 · challenge gtr-12-6 “Blues challenge” · step 4 (along) · title
Guitar · Unit 13 “Lead technique” · title

rows.source: Hammer-ons, pull-offs, slides, bends and vibrato, and a second pentatonic box.
rows.translation: Hammer-on, pull-off, slide, bend og vibrato tækni, og annað fimmtóna mynstur.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 13 “Lead technique” · unit summary
Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-1 “Hammer-ons” · title
Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-1 “Hammer-ons” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: A hammer-on sounds a second note with the fretting hand alone. Pick a note, then bring another finger down hard, just behind a higher fret. The string keeps ringing.
rows.translation: Hammer-on lætur annan tón hljóma með griphendinni einni. Plokkaðu tón og láttu svo annan fingur lenda ákveðið rétt aftan við hærra band. Strengurinn heldur áfram að óma.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-1 “Hammer-ons” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Pick open string 3, then hammer finger 2 onto fret 2. Don't pick the second note.
rows.translation: Plokkaðu opinn streng 3 og sláðu svo fingri 2 niður við band 2. Ekki plokka seinni tóninn.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-1 “Hammer-ons” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: String 3: pick fret 5 with finger 1, then hammer finger 3 onto fret 7.
rows.translation: Strengur 3: haltu bandi 5 með fingri 1 og plokkaðu, sláðu svo fingri 3 niður við band 7.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-1 “Hammer-ons” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: What makes a hammer-on ring clearly?
rows.translation: Hvað gefur hreinan hljóm í hammer-on?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-1 “Hammer-ons” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-1 “Hammer-ons” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: A fast, firm landing right behind the fret
rows.translation: Hröð, ákveðin lending rétt aftan við bandið
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-1 “Hammer-ons” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-1 “Hammer-ons” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Speed and aim matter more than force. Land on the fingertip, right behind the fret, and the string keeps singing.
rows.translation: Hraði og miðun skipta meira máli en afl. Lentu á fingurgómnum rétt aftan við bandið og strengurinn heldur áfram að syngja.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-1 “Hammer-ons” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-2 “Pull-offs” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: A pull-off drops to a lower note. With both fingers down, pick the higher note, then flick the top finger off sideways so it plucks the string as it leaves.
rows.translation: Pull-off fellur niður á lægri tón. Hafðu báða fingur niðri, plokkaðu hærri tóninn og kipptu svo efri fingrinum til hliðar af strengnum svo hann plokki um leið.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-2 “Pull-offs” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Fret 2 on string 3, then flick finger 2 off to sound open G.
rows.translation: Band 2 á streng 3, kipptu svo fingri 2 af til að láta opið G hljóma.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-2 “Pull-offs” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Fingers 1 and 3 on frets 5 and 7. Pick, then pull finger 3 off.
rows.translation: Fingur 1 og 3 á böndum 5 og 7. Plokkaðu og kipptu svo fingri 3 af.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-2 “Pull-offs” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: In a pull-off, the top finger…
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-2 “Pull-offs” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-2 “Pull-offs” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-2 “Pull-offs” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Flicks off sideways, plucking the string
rows.translation: Til hliðar af strengnum og plokkar hann
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-2 “Pull-offs” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Lifting straight up lets the note die. A small sideways flick plucks the lower note into life.
rows.translation: Ef þú lyftir beint upp deyr tónninn. Lítill kippur til hliðar plokkar lægri tóninn af stað.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-2 “Pull-offs” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-3 “Slides” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: To slide, pick a note and keep pressing as you glide the same finger to a new fret. The pressure carries the sound; only the first note is picked.
rows.translation: Í slide plokkarðu tón og heldur þrýstingnum á meðan þú rennir sama fingri á nýtt band. Þrýstingurinn ber hljóðið áfram; aðeins fyrsti tónninn er plokkaður.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-3 “Slides” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Finger 3 on string 3, fret 7. Pick, then slide up to fret 9 without lifting.
rows.translation: Fingur 3 á streng 3 við band 7. Plokkaðu og renndu svo upp á band 9 án þess að lyfta.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-3 “Slides” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: During a slide, what keeps the note sounding?
rows.translation: Hvað heldur tóninum hljómandi í slide?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-3 “Slides” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-3 “Slides” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-3 “Slides” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-3 “Slides” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Ease off and the note dies. Keep the same pressure all the way to the new fret.
rows.translation: Ef þú slakar á deyr tónninn. Haltu sama þrýstingi alla leið að nýja bandinu.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-3 “Slides” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Now back: pick fret 9 and slide down to fret 7.
rows.translation: Nú til baka: plokkaðu við band 9 og renndu niður á band 7.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-3 “Slides” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise

Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-4 “Bends and vibrato” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: A bend pushes the string across the fret to raise its pitch. A whole-step bend, the size of two frets, from fret 7 must sound exactly like fret 9.
rows.translation: Í bend ýtirðu strengnum þvert yfir bandið til að hækka tóninn. Heiltónsbeygja, sem nemur tveimur böndum, frá bandi 7 verður að hljóma nákvæmlega eins og band 9.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-4 “Bends and vibrato” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: String 3, fret 9: this is your bend target. Let it ring and remember it.
rows.translation: Strengur 3, band 9: þetta er marktónn beygjunnar. Láttu hann óma og mundu hann.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-4 “Bends and vibrato” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-4 “Bends and vibrato” · step 3 (explain) · title

rows.source: Put finger 3 on fret 7 with fingers 1 and 2 behind it on the same string. Push all three toward the ceiling, turning your wrist as if turning a doorknob.
rows.translation: Settu fingur 3 á band 7 með fingur 1 og 2 aftan við hann á sama streng. Ýttu öllum þremur að loftinu og snúðu úlnliðnum eins og þú snúir hurðarhúni.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-4 “Bends and vibrato” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Your bend from fret 7 sounds lower than fret 9. What now?
rows.translation: Beygjan frá bandi 7 hljómar lægra en band 9. Hvað nú?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-4 “Bends and vibrato” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-4 “Bends and vibrato” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-4 “Bends and vibrato” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-4 “Bends and vibrato” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: A bend that falls short sounds sour. Push until it matches the target you heard.
rows.translation: Beygja sem nær ekki nógu hátt hljómar falskt. Ýttu þar til hún passar við marktóninn sem þú heyrðir.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-4 “Bends and vibrato” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Target, then a short bend. Same note or different?
rows.translation: Marktónn, svo beygja sem nær ekki alveg upp. Sami tónn eða ólíkur?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-4 “Bends and vibrato” · step 5 (listen) · question or instruction

Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-4 “Bends and vibrato” · step 6 (explain) · title

rows.source: Vibrato is a small bend and release, repeated quickly on a held note. Keep it narrow and even so the note stays in tune.
rows.translation: Vibrato er lítil beygja og slökun, endurtekið hratt á tóni sem er haldið. Hafðu það þröngt og jafnt svo tónninn haldist hreinn.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-4 “Bends and vibrato” · step 6 (explain) · lesson card text
Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-4 “Bends and vibrato” · step 7 (along) · title

Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-5 “Box 2 and the link” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: The same five notes repeat up the neck. Box 2 starts where box 1 ends: finger 1 at fret 7 on strings 5, 4 and 3, finger 2 at fret 8 on strings 6, 2 and 1.
rows.translation: Sömu fimm tónar endurtaka sig upp eftir hálsinum. Mynstur 2 byrjar þar sem mynstur 1 endar: fingur 1 við band 7 á strengjum 5, 4 og 3, fingur 2 við band 8 á strengjum 6, 2 og 1.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-5 “Box 2 and the link” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: String 6: frets 8 and 10. String 5: frets 7 and 10.
rows.translation: Strengur 6: bönd 8 og 10. Strengur 5: bönd 7 og 10.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-5 “Box 2 and the link” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-5 “Box 2 and the link” · step 3 (along) · title
Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-5 “Box 2 and the link” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: The same five notes as box 1, A C D E G, in a new place on the neck.
rows.translation: Sömu fimm tónar og í mynstri 1, A C D E G, á nýjum stað á hálsinum.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-5 “Box 2 and the link” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-5 “Box 2 and the link” · step 6 (explain) · title

rows.source: To travel from box 1 to box 2, slide finger 3 from fret 7 to fret 9 on string 3. You arrive in box 2 with your hand already in place.
rows.translation: Til að fara úr mynstri 1 í mynstur 2 rennirðu fingri 3 frá bandi 7 að bandi 9 á streng 3. Þú kemur í mynstur 2 með höndina þegar á sínum stað.

rows.source: Saltwater Sunday is a Timbre Original: laid-back reggae in A minor, where Am7 and D7 trade bars. Both pentatonic boxes fit over them. Hammer, pull and slide, and land on a chord note as each bar begins. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
rows.translation: Saltvatnssunnudagur er frumsamið lag frá Timbre: afslappað reggí í A-moll, þar sem Am7 og D7 skiptast á töktum. Bæði fimmtóna mynstrin passa yfir. Notaðu hammer-on, pull-off og slide og lentu á hljómtóni í upphafi hvers takts. Allt lagið er á flipanum Lög, undir Frumsamin lög.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-spotlight “Song spotlight: Saltwater Sunday” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-spotlight “Song spotlight: Saltwater Sunday” · step 2 (along) · title

rows.source: Over D7, which of these box notes belongs to the chord?
rows.translation: Yfir D7, hver þessara tóna úr mynstrinu tilheyrir hljómnum?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-spotlight “Song spotlight: Saltwater Sunday” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: D7 is D, F sharp, A and C. C, its seventh, sounds settled; E and G only pass through.
rows.translation: D7 er D, hækkað F, A og C. C, sjöund hans, hljómar stöðugt; E og G fara aðeins í gegnum.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-spotlight “Song spotlight: Saltwater Sunday” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Your break over Am7 and D7
rows.translation: Sólókaflinn þinn yfir Am7 og D7

rows.source: No new ideas: hammer-ons, pull-offs, slides, bend targets, vibrato and both boxes. Play each phrase cleanly, then make it sing.
rows.translation: Ekkert nýtt: hammer-on, pull-off, slide, marktónar fyrir bend, vibrato og bæði mynstrin. Spilaðu hverja hendingu hreint og láttu hana svo syngja.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · challenge gtr-13-6 “Lead challenge” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: A whole-step bend from fret 7 should match…
rows.translation: Heiltónsbeygja frá bandi 7 á að passa við…

rows.translation: Marktónn, svo beygja. Sami tónn eða ólíkur?

rows.source: E and A shapes up the neck, major and minor, the closer shape, and a progression in A.
rows.translation: E- og A-grip upp eftir hálsinum, dúr og moll, nærgripið og hljómaröð í A.

Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-1 “The E shape moves” · title
Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-1 “The E shape moves” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Your F barre is an E shape with a barre at fret 1. Slide the whole thing up and the name follows the root on string 6: at fret 3 it's G, at fret 5 it's A.
rows.translation: F-barrégripið þitt er E-grip með barré við band 1. Renndu því öllu upp og nafnið fylgir grunntóninum á streng 6: við band 3 er það G, við band 5 er það A.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-1 “The E shape moves” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: An E-shape barre at fret 5. Which chord?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-1 “The E shape moves” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: String 6 counts up from E: F at 1, G at 3, A at 5. The barre's fret names the chord.
rows.translation: Strengur 6 er talinn upp frá E: F við 1, G við 3, A við 5. Band barrégripsins gefur hljómnum nafn.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-1 “The E shape moves” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-1 “The E shape moves” · step 5 (explain) · title

rows.source: Lift finger 2 and let the barre cover string 3. That's the E minor shape, and it moves the same way: F sharp minor at fret 2, A minor at fret 5.
rows.translation: Lyftu fingri 2 og láttu barrégripið ná yfir streng 3. Það er E-moll gripið og það færist á sama hátt: hækkað F-moll við band 2, A-moll við band 5.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-1 “The E shape moves” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text
Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-2 “The A shape moves” · title
Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-2 “The A shape moves” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: B minor was an A minor shape with a barre. The major A shape moves too: barre strings 1 to 5, then lay finger 3 flat across strings 4, 3 and 2, two frets higher.
rows.translation: B-moll var A-moll grip með barré. A-dúr gripið færist líka: legðu barré yfir strengi 1 til 5, svo fingur 3 flatan yfir strengi 4, 3 og 2, tveimur böndum ofar.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-2 “The A shape moves” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: An A-shape barre at fret 3. Which chord?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-2 “The A shape moves” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: String 5 counts up from A: B at 2, C at 3, D at 5.
rows.translation: Strengur 5 er talinn upp frá A: B við 2, C við 3, D við 5.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-2 “The A shape moves” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: The minor A shape moves too
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-2 “The A shape moves” · step 5 (explain) · title

rows.source: For minor, use your B minor fingers: 2, 3 and 4 build the A minor pattern in front of the barre. At fret 3 that's C minor.
rows.translation: Fyrir moll notarðu B-moll fingurna: 2, 3 og 4 byggja A-moll mynstrið framan við barrégripið. Við band 3 er það C-moll.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-2 “The A shape moves” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text

Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-3 “E shape or A shape?” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Most chords can be an E shape, root on string 6, or an A shape, root on string 5. Pick whichever sits closer to where your hand already is.
rows.translation: Flesta hljóma má spila sem E-grip, með grunntón á streng 6, eða A-grip, með grunntón á streng 5. Veldu gripið sem er nær staðnum þar sem höndin er þegar.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-3 “E shape or A shape?” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: You're playing G at fret 3. Where's the closest C?
rows.translation: Þú spilar G við band 3. Hvar er næsta C?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-3 “E shape or A shape?” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction
Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-3 “E shape or A shape?” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: C's root is on string 5, fret 3. Stay at fret 3 and switch to the A shape.
rows.translation: Grunntónn C er á streng 5 við band 3. Haltu þig við band 3 og skiptu yfir í A-gripið.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-3 “E shape or A shape?” · step 2 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-3 “E shape or A shape?” · step 4 (explain) · title

rows.source: From G to C at fret 3, finger 1 stays on the barre. Only the fingers in front of it change. It's the smoothest barre change there is.
rows.translation: Úr G í C við band 3 helst fingur 1 í barrégripinu. Aðeins fingurnir framan við hann breytast. Þetta eru mýkstu barréskiptin sem til eru.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-3 “E shape or A shape?” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: D as an A shape sits at which fret?
rows.translation: Við hvaða band er D sem A-grip?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-3 “E shape or A shape?” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Let the barre go soft for an instant as you move, then squeeze as you land. Gripping hard all the way tires your hand and slows the change.
rows.translation: Slakaðu örstutt á barrégripinu þegar þú færir það og þrýstu svo þegar þú lendir. Að halda fast allan tímann þreytir höndina og hægir á skiptunum.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-5 “Smooth barre changes” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: When should your fretting hand squeeze?

Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-5 “Smooth barre changes” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Squeeze to land, relax to move. Constant force wears out your hand in minutes.
rows.translation: Þrýstu þegar þú lendir, slakaðu á þegar þú færir. Stöðugur kraftur þreytir höndina á fáeinum mínútum.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-5 “Smooth barre changes” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-5 “Smooth barre changes” · step 4 (explain) · title

rows.source: On the last up strum before a change, lift the barre and keep strumming. The open strings sound for a moment, the rhythm never stops, and you land on time.
rows.translation: Á síðasta uppslætti fyrir skipti lyftirðu barrégripinu og heldur áfram að slá. Opnu strengirnir hljóma augnablik, hrynjandin stoppar aldrei og þú lendir á réttum tíma.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-5 “Smooth barre changes” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Spray Paint Sunrise is a Timbre Original: indie pop in E on E, B, C sharp minor and A. B and C sharp minor are both A-shape barres, two frets apart, so one hand shape does most of the work. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
rows.translation: Spreymáluð sólarupprás er frumsamið lag frá Timbre: indípopp í E með E, B, hækkuðu C-moll og A. B og hækkað C-moll eru bæði A-barrégrip, tveimur böndum í sundur, svo eitt handgrip vinnur mest af verkinu. Allt lagið er á flipanum Lög, undir Frumsamin lög.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-spotlight “Song spotlight: Spray Paint Sunrise” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: C sharp minor as an A minor shape barre sits at…
rows.translation: Hækkað C-moll sem A-moll barrégrip er við…

rows.source: Funk sixteenths and scratches, the reggae chop, country boom-chick and a syncopated pop strum.
rows.translation: Fönk-sextándapartar og skrap, reggí-högg, kántrí-búmm-tsjikk og poppyfirsláttur með áherslufærslu.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 “Rhythm styles” · unit summary
Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-1 “Sixteenth notes” · title
Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-1 “Sixteenth notes” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Sixteenth notes split each beat in four: one-e-and-a, two-e-and-a. Your strumming hand doubles its speed, down-up-down-up inside every beat.
rows.translation: Sextándapartsnótur skipta hverju slagi í fernt: einn-e-og-a, tveir-e-og-a. Sláttarhöndin tvöfaldar hraðann: niður-upp-niður-upp innan hvers slags.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-1 “Sixteenth notes” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: How many sixteenth notes fill one beat?
rows.translation: Hve margar sextándapartsnótur fylla eitt slag?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-1 “Sixteenth notes” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: One-e-and-a: four even slices of every beat.
rows.translation: Einn-e-og-a: fjórir jafnir hlutar á hverju slagi.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-1 “Sixteenth notes” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-1 “Sixteenth notes” · step 5 (explain) · title

rows.source: Funk loves the ninth chord. Finger 2 on string 5, fret 7, finger 1 on string 4, fret 6, and finger 3 flat across strings 3, 2 and 1 at fret 7.
rows.translation: Fönk elskar níundarhljóminn. Fingur 2 á streng 5 við band 7, fingur 1 á streng 4 við band 6 og fingur 3 flatur yfir strengi 3, 2 og 1 við band 7.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-1 “Sixteenth notes” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text
Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-2 “Funk: scratches and hits” · title
Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-2 “Funk: scratches and hits” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Keep your hand moving in sixteenths, but relax your fretting fingers so most strums are dead, scratchy clicks. Press down only for the hits.
rows.translation: Haltu hendinni á hreyfingu í sextándapörtum en slakaðu á gripfingrunum svo flestir yfirslættir verði þurrir, skrapandi smellir. Þrýstu aðeins niður fyrir höggin.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-2 “Funk: scratches and hits” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-2 “Funk: scratches and hits” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Fretting fingers resting lightly on the strings
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-2 “Funk: scratches and hits” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-2 “Funk: scratches and hits” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-2 “Funk: scratches and hits” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Touching without pressing stops the strings from ringing. The strum turns into a crisp, percussive click.
rows.translation: Snerting án þrýstings stöðvar ómun strengjanna. Yfirslátturinn verður að skýrum, sláttarhljóðslegum smelli.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-2 “Funk: scratches and hits” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-2 “Funk: scratches and hits” · step 5 (explain) · title

rows.source: Squeeze for each hit, then relax right away so it stays short. Slide the whole E9 shape down two frets and you have D9.
rows.translation: Þrýstu fyrir hvert högg og slakaðu strax á svo það verði stutt. Renndu öllu E9-gripinu niður um tvö bönd og þú færð D9.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-2 “Funk: scratches and hits” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text
Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-3 “Reggae: the offbeat chop” · title

rows.translation: Högg á öðru og fjórða slagi
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-3 “Reggae: the offbeat chop” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Reggae guitar answers the drums with short, bright chords on beats two and four. Strum just the thin strings and cut each chord off right away.
rows.translation: Reggígítar svarar trommunum með stuttum, björtum hljómum á öðru og fjórða slagi. Sláðu aðeins yfir þunnu strengina og þaggaðu hvern hljóm strax.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-3 “Reggae: the offbeat chop” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-3 “Reggae: the offbeat chop” · step 3 (explain) · title

rows.source: Use the top four strings only. This A minor is the top of your A minor barre at fret 5: finger 3 on string 4, fret 7, finger 1 barring the rest.
rows.translation: Notaðu aðeins fjóra efstu strengina. Þetta A-moll er efsti hluti A-moll barrégripsins við band 5: fingur 3 á streng 4 við band 7, fingur 1 í barré yfir hina.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-3 “Reggae: the offbeat chop” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: How long should a reggae chop ring?
rows.translation: Hve lengi á reggí-högg að óma?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-3 “Reggae: the offbeat chop” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-3 “Reggae: the offbeat chop” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-3 “Reggae: the offbeat chop” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-3 “Reggae: the offbeat chop” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Squeeze, strum, release. The chop is a short bark, and the space after it is the groove.
rows.translation: Þrýstu, sláðu, slepptu. Höggið er stuttur hvellur og bilið á eftir gefur hrynjandina.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-3 “Reggae: the offbeat chop” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-3 “Reggae: the offbeat chop” · step 6 (explain) · title

rows.source: Now the top of your D barre: finger 3 flat across strings 4, 3 and 2 at fret 7, finger 1 on string 1 at fret 5.
rows.translation: Nú efsti hluti D-barrégripsins: fingur 3 flatur yfir strengi 4, 3 og 2 við band 7, fingur 1 á streng 1 við band 5.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-3 “Reggae: the offbeat chop” · step 6 (explain) · lesson card text

Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-4 “Country boom-chick” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Country rhythm splits the bar: a single bass note on beats one and three, a quick strum of the thin strings on two and four. Boom, chick, boom, chick.
rows.translation: Kántríhrynjandi skiptir taktinum: stakur bassatónn á fyrsta og þriðja slagi, snöggur yfirsláttur á þunnu strengjunum á öðru og fjórða. Búmm, tsjikk, búmm, tsjikk.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-4 “Country boom-chick” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: In boom-chick, what happens on beats two and four?
rows.translation: Hvað gerist á öðru og fjórða slagi í búmm-tsjikk?

rows.source: Move the second boom to another string: in G, string 6 then string 4. In C, string 5 then 4. In D, string 4 then open string 5.
rows.translation: Færðu seinna búmmið á annan streng: í G, strengur 6 og svo strengur 4. Í C, strengur 5 og svo 4. Í D, strengur 4 og svo opinn strengur 5.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-4 “Country boom-chick” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Booms in G, C and D

Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-5 “The syncopated pop strum” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Syncopation puts the strum where you don't expect it. Down on one, up on the and of two, up on the and of three, then down-up on four.
rows.translation: Áherslufærsla setur yfirsláttinn þar sem þú átt ekki von á honum. Niður á fyrsta slagi, upp á og eftir annað, upp á og eftir þriðja og svo niður-upp á fjórða.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-5 “The syncopated pop strum” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: In this pattern, what does your hand do on beat two?
rows.translation: Hvað gerir höndin á öðru slagi í þessu mynstri?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-5 “The syncopated pop strum” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-5 “The syncopated pop strum” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: The pendulum never stops. On two the hand swings down without touching, ready for the up strum.
rows.translation: Pendúllinn stoppar aldrei. Á öðru slagi sveiflast höndin niður án snertingar, tilbúin fyrir yfirsláttinn upp.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-5 “The syncopated pop strum” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-5 “The syncopated pop strum” · step 6 (explain) · title

rows.source: Pop players often change chords on the last up strum, the and of four, so the new chord arrives a hair early. It pushes the song forward.
rows.translation: Poppspilarar skipta oft um hljóma á síðasta uppslætti, og eftir fjórða slag, svo nýi hljómurinn komi örlítið snemma. Það ýtir laginu áfram.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-5 “The syncopated pop strum” · step 6 (explain) · lesson card text
