rows.source: In G, the chords G, C and D7 do most of the work, with E minor for a darker color. D7 pulls back to G the way G7 pulls to C.
rows.translation: Í G vinna hljómarnir G, C og D7 mestallt verkið, með E-moll fyrir dekkri lit. D7 togar aftur í G eins og G7 togar í C.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-2 “D7 and the key of G” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: B minor and the key of D
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-3 “B minor and the key of D” · title
Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-3 “B minor and the key of D” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Lay finger 1 across strings 3, 2 and 1 at fret 2, then reach finger 3 to string 4, fret 4.
rows.translation: Leggðu fingur 1 yfir strengi 3, 2 og 1 í 2. bandi og teygðu svo fingur 3 á streng 4 í 4. bandi.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-3 “B minor and the key of D” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: D and B minor both press fret 2 on which strings?
rows.translation: Á hvaða strengjum er þrýst í 2. band í bæði D og B-moll?
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-3 “B minor and the key of D” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-3 “B minor and the key of D” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-3 “B minor and the key of D” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-3 “B minor and the key of D” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Both chords hold fret 2 on strings 3 and 2. Only the outer strings change.
rows.translation: Í báðum hljómum er haldið í 2. bandi á strengjum 3 og 2. Aðeins ystu strengirnir breytast.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-3 “B minor and the key of D” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-3 “B minor and the key of D” · step 4 (explain) · title

rows.source: In D, the chords D, G and A7 carry the song, and B minor adds a sad one. A7 is a single finger: string 3, fret 1.
rows.translation: Í D bera hljómarnir D, G og A7 lagið og B-moll bætir við dapurlegum hljómi. A7 er einn fingur: strengur 3, band 1.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-3 “B minor and the key of D” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text
Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-4 “Same numbers, new key” · title
Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-4 “Same numbers, new key” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: A song's chords are steps of its key: I, IV and V. Change key and the numbers stay. In C that's C, F and G7; in G, it's G, C and D7; in F, F, B flat and C7.
rows.translation: Hljómar lags eru tónsæti tóntegundarinnar: I, IV og V. Skiptu um tóntegund og tölurnar haldast. Í C eru það C, F og G7; í G eru það G, C og D7; í F eru það F, lækkað B og C7.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-4 “Same numbers, new key” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: In the key of F, which chord is IV?
rows.translation: Hvaða hljómur er IV í F?
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-4 “Same numbers, new key” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Count up from F: F, G, A, B flat. The fourth note is B flat.
rows.translation: Teldu upp frá F: F, G, A, lækkað B. Fjórði tónninn er lækkað B.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-4 “Same numbers, new key” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-4 “Same numbers, new key” · step 6 (explain) · title

rows.source: If a song sits too high or too low to sing, move it to another key. Same numbers, same song, just a better fit for the voice.
rows.translation: Ef lag liggur of hátt eða lágt fyrir söng skaltu færa það í aðra tóntegund. Sömu tölur, sama lag, bara þægilegra fyrir röddina.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-4 “Same numbers, new key” · step 6 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: In the key of D, which chord is V?
rows.translation: Hvaða hljómur er V í D?
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-4 “Same numbers, new key” · step 7 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Count up from D: D, E, F sharp, G, A. A is the fifth note, so A7 is the V chord.
rows.translation: Teldu upp frá D: D, E, hækkað F, G, A. A er fimmti tónninn, svo A7 er V-hljómurinn.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-4 “Same numbers, new key” · step 7 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-5 “G minor and minor keys” · title
Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-5 “G minor and minor keys” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Finger 2 on string 3, fret 2, finger 3 on string 2, fret 3, and finger 1 on string 1, fret 1. String 4 rings open.
rows.translation: Fingur 2 á streng 3 í 2. bandi, fingur 3 á streng 2 í 3. bandi og fingur 1 á streng 1 í 1. bandi. Strengur 4 ómar opinn.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-5 “G minor and minor keys” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-5 “G minor and minor keys” · step 4 (explain) · title

rows.source: D minor's family is D minor, G minor and A7. A7 pulls home to D minor, the way E7 pulls to A minor.
rows.translation: Fjölskylda D-moll er D-moll, G-moll og A7. A7 togar heim í D-moll eins og E7 togar í A-moll.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-5 “G minor and minor keys” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text
Ukulele · Unit 7 · challenge uke-7-6 “Challenge: new keys” · title
Ukulele · Unit 7 · challenge uke-7-6 “Challenge: new keys” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: No new ideas: B flat, D7, B minor and G minor, and the keys of C, G, F and D. Clean shapes first, then a steady strum.
rows.translation: Engar nýjar hugmyndir: lækkað B, D7, B-moll og G-moll og tóntegundirnar C, G, F og D. Hrein grip fyrst og svo jafn yfirsláttur.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 · challenge uke-7-6 “Challenge: new keys” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: In the key of G, which chord is V?
rows.translation: Hvaða hljómur er V í G?
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 · challenge uke-7-6 “Challenge: new keys” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
Ukulele · Unit 8 “Strum styles” · title

rows.source: The chunk, the island strum with a backbeat, swing and the ragtime chords, accents in 3-3-2, and the waltz.
rows.translation: Dempisláttur, eyjayfirsláttur með bakslögum, sveifla og ragtime-hljómar, áherslur í 3-3-2 og vals.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 8 “Strum styles” · unit summary
Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-1 “The chunk” · title
Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-1 “The chunk” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: A chunk is a strum that stops dead. Strum down and let the side of your palm land on the strings at the same moment: a short, dry click, like a snare drum.
rows.translation: Dempisláttur er yfirsláttur sem stöðvast snögglega. Sláðu niður og láttu jaðar lófans lenda á strengjunum um leið: stuttur, þurr smellur eins og sneriltromma.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-1 “The chunk” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-1 “The chunk” · step 2 (explain) · title

rows.source: Strum down on 1, chunk on 2, down-up on 3, chunk on 4. The chunks fall where a drummer hits the snare.
rows.translation: Sláðu niður á 1, dempislátt á 2, niður-upp á 3, dempislátt á 4. Dempislættirnir falla þar sem trommari slær á snerilinn.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-1 “The chunk” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text
Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-1 “The chunk” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-1 “The chunk” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer
Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-1 “The chunk” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer
Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-1 “The chunk” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Two and four are the backbeat, where the snare drum plays. A chunk there gives the strum a drummer's punch.
rows.translation: Tvö og fjögur eru bakslögin, þar sem sneriltromman spilar. Dempisláttur þar gefur yfirslættinum kraft trommuleikara.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-1 “The chunk” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-2 “Island strum with a chunk” · title

rows.source: Swap one down for a chunk
rows.translation: Skiptu einu niðurstriki út fyrir dempislátt
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-2 “Island strum with a chunk” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Take the island strum, D, DU, UDU, and turn the down on 2 into a chunk. The rhythm stays the same; the groove gets a backbeat.
rows.translation: Taktu eyjayfirsláttinn, D, DU, UDU, og breyttu niðurstrikinu á 2 í dempislátt. Hrynjandin er sú sama; sveiflan fær bakslög.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-2 “Island strum with a chunk” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: In this strum, which stroke becomes the chunk?
rows.translation: Hvaða strik verður dempislátturinn í þessum yfirslætti?
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-2 “Island strum with a chunk” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-2 “Island strum with a chunk” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-2 “Island strum with a chunk” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Beat 1 rings out, beat 2 clicks. Everything else stays where the island strum had it.
rows.translation: Slag 1 ómar, slag 2 smellur. Allt annað helst þar sem það var í eyjayfirslættinum.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-2 “Island strum with a chunk” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-3 “Swing and the ragtime chords” · title

rows.source: Swing splits each beat unevenly: a long down, then a short up. Say hum-pty, dum-pty as you strum. It's the bounce of old ukulele tunes.
rows.translation: Sveifla skiptir hverju slagi ójafnt: langt niðurstrik og svo stutt uppstrik. Segðu dúm-da, dúm-da meðan þú slærð yfir. Þetta er skoppið í gömlum úkúlelelögum.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-3 “Swing and the ragtime chords” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-3 “Swing and the ragtime chords” · step 4 (explain) · title

rows.source: C, A7, D7, G7, then home to C. Each seventh chord pulls to the next, a little chain of tension. It powered countless songs a century ago.
rows.translation: C, A7, D7, G7 og svo heim í C. Hver sjöundarhljómur togar í þann næsta, lítil keðja spennu. Hún knúði ótal lög fyrir öld síðan.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-3 “Swing and the ragtime chords” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Which chord does D7 pull toward here?
rows.translation: Í hvaða hljóm togar D7 hér?
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-3 “Swing and the ragtime chords” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: D7 leads to G, and G7 leads home to C. Each chord sets up the next.
rows.translation: D7 leiðir í G og G7 leiðir heim í C. Hver hljómur undirbýr þann næsta.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-3 “Swing and the ragtime chords” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-4 “Accents in 3-3-2” · title
Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-4 “Accents in 3-3-2” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Strum steady down-up eighths, but hit three of them harder: 1, the and of 2, and 4. The accents fall 3, 3 and 2 eighths apart.
rows.translation: Sláðu jafnar áttundapartsnótur niður-upp, en þrjár þeirra fastar: 1, og eftir 2 og 4. Áherslurnar eru með 3, 3 og 2 áttundapartsnótna millibili.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-4 “Accents in 3-3-2” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-4 “Accents in 3-3-2” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-4 “Accents in 3-3-2” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-4 “Accents in 3-3-2” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Count 1 2 3, 1 2 3, 1 2 across the bar's eight eighths. Each 1 is an accent.
rows.translation: Teldu 1 2 3, 1 2 3, 1 2 yfir átta áttundapartsnótur taktsins. Hver 1 er áhersla.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-4 “Accents in 3-3-2” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-4 “Accents in 3-3-2” · step 5 (explain) · title

rows.source: George Formby's split stroke on the banjo ukulele puts its big strums in the same three places, with single strings in between. Master the accents first.
rows.translation: Klofinn yfirsláttur George Formby á banjóúkúlele setur stóru yfirslættina á sömu þrjá staðina, með stökum strengjum á milli. Náðu fyrst tökum á áherslunum.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-4 “Accents in 3-3-2” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text
Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-5 “Waltz strums” · title
Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-5 “Waltz strums” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: In three, strum down on 1, then down-up on 2 and on 3: D, DU, DU. Lean on 1 so the sway is clear.
rows.translation: Í þrískiptum takti slærðu niður á 1, svo niður-upp á 2 og á 3: D, DU, DU. Leggðu þunga á 1 svo vaggið sé skýrt.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-5 “Waltz strums” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: How many strums fill this bar of three?
rows.translation: Hversu margir yfirslættir fylla þennan þriggja slaga takt?
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-5 “Waltz strums” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Down on 1, then down-up on 2 and on 3: one plus two plus two.
rows.translation: Niður á 1, svo niður-upp á 2 og á 3: einn plús tveir plús tveir.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-5 “Waltz strums” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
Ukulele · Unit 8 · challenge uke-8-6 “Challenge: strum styles” · title
Ukulele · Unit 8 · challenge uke-8-6 “Challenge: strum styles” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: No new ideas: chunks, the island strum with a chunk, swing, the 3-3-2 accents and the waltz. Keep the hand moving and let the accents speak.
rows.translation: Engar nýjar hugmyndir: dempislættir, eyjayfirsláttur með dempislætti, sveifla, 3-3-2-áherslurnar og valsinn. Haltu höndinni á hreyfingu og leyfðu áherslunum að tala.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 8 · challenge uke-8-6 “Challenge: strum styles” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: In a swing strum, each beat splits into…
rows.translation: Í sveifluyfirslætti skiptist hvert slag í…
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 8 · challenge uke-8-6 “Challenge: strum styles” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
Ukulele · Unit 9 “Fingerpicking and chord melody” · title

rows.source: One finger per string, rolling patterns, the alternating thumb, and a tune picked from inside its chords.
rows.translation: Einn fingur á streng, rúllandi mynstur, víxlþumall og laglína plokkuð innan úr hljómunum.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 9 “Fingerpicking and chord melody” · unit summary
Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-1 “One finger per string” · title
Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-1 “One finger per string” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Rest your thumb on string 4, index on string 3, middle on string 2 and ring finger on string 1. Each one plucks only its own string.
rows.translation: Láttu þumalinn hvíla á streng 4, vísifingur á streng 3, langatöng á streng 2 og baugfingur á streng 1. Hver plokkar aðeins sinn streng.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-1 “One finger per string” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Thumb, index, middle, ring: strings 4, 3, 2 and 1.
rows.translation: Þumall, vísifingur, langatöng, baugfingur: strengir 4, 3, 2 og 1.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-1 “One finger per string” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-1 “One finger per string” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Thumb on 4, index on 3, middle on 2, ring on 1: one finger per string.
rows.translation: Þumall á 4, vísifingur á 3, langatöng á 2, baugfingur á 1: einn fingur á streng.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-1 “One finger per string” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-1 “One finger per string” · step 4 (along) · title
Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-1 “One finger per string” · step 5 (explain) · title

rows.source: Because string 4 is a high G, the pattern zigzags: high, low, then climbing. That sparkle is the sound of fingerpicked ukulele.
rows.translation: Þar sem strengur 4 er hátt G fer mynstrið í sikksakk: hátt, lágt og svo upp. Þessi glampi er hljómur fingraspils á úkúlele.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-1 “One finger per string” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text
Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-1 “One finger per string” · step 6 (along) · title

rows.source: A minor, F, C, G7, in eighths
rows.translation: A-moll, F, C, G7, í áttundapartsnótum
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-1 “One finger per string” · step 7 (along) · title
Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-2 “Rolling patterns” · title
Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-2 “Rolling patterns” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Pluck strings 4, 3, 2 and 1, then come back on 2 and 3: thumb, index, middle, ring, middle, index. Six notes fill a bar of three.
rows.translation: Plokkaðu strengi 4, 3, 2 og 1 og komdu svo til baka á 2 og 3: þumall, vísifingur, langatöng, baugfingur, langatöng, vísifingur. Sex tónar fylla þriggja slaga takt.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-2 “Rolling patterns” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-2 “Rolling patterns” · step 2 (along) · title

rows.source: After the ring finger plucks string 1, which finger comes next?
rows.translation: Hvaða fingur kemur næst eftir að baugfingurinn plokkar streng 1?
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-2 “Rolling patterns” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-2 “Rolling patterns” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-2 “Rolling patterns” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: The roll turns around at the top: ring on string 1, then middle on 2 and index on 3.
rows.translation: Rúllan snýr við efst: baugfingur á streng 1, svo langatöng á 2 og vísifingur á 3.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-2 “Rolling patterns” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-2 “Rolling patterns” · step 5 (explain) · title

rows.source: Land the new chord as the thumb starts the next bar. The fingers keep rolling; only the shape under them changes.
rows.translation: Lentu á nýja hljómnum þegar þumallinn byrjar næsta takt. Fingurnir halda áfram að rúlla; aðeins gripið undir þeim breytist.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-2 “Rolling patterns” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: C, A minor, D minor, G7
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-2 “Rolling patterns” · step 7 (along) · title
Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-3 “The alternating thumb” · title
Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-3 “The alternating thumb” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Now the thumb rocks between strings 3 and 4 on the beats while your fingers pluck strings 2 and 1 in between. It's the ukulele's version of Travis picking.
rows.translation: Nú vaggar þumallinn milli strengja 3 og 4 á slögunum meðan fingurnir plokka strengi 2 og 1 á milli. Þetta er úkúleleútgáfan af Travis-fingraspili.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-3 “The alternating thumb” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-3 “The alternating thumb” · step 3 (along) · title

rows.source: In this pattern, what does the thumb do?
rows.translation: Hvað gerir þumallinn í þessu mynstri?
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-3 “The alternating thumb” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-3 “The alternating thumb” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-3 “The alternating thumb” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: The thumb keeps the pulse, a note on every beat, while the fingers fill the gaps.
rows.translation: Þumallinn heldur púlsinum, einn tónn á hverju slagi, meðan fingurnir fylla í eyðurnar.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-3 “The alternating thumb” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-3 “The alternating thumb” · step 5 (along) · title
Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-3 “The alternating thumb” · step 6 (along) · title
Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-4 “Melody inside the chord” · title

rows.source: Hold the chord, pick the tune
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-4 “Melody inside the chord” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: In chord melody, your fretting hand holds the chord and you pick the tune from inside it. Hold F, and C, F and A are already under your fingers.
rows.translation: Í hljómalaglínu heldur griphöndin hljómnum og þú plokkar laglínuna innan úr honum. Haltu F og C, F og A eru þegar undir fingrunum.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-4 “Melody inside the chord” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Hold F: open string 3, string 2 at fret 1, open string 1. That's how Amazing Grace begins.
rows.translation: Haltu F: opinn strengur 3, strengur 2 í 1. bandi, opinn strengur 1. Þannig byrjar Amazing Grace.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-4 “Melody inside the chord” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-4 “Melody inside the chord” · step 3 (explain) · title

rows.source: When the tune leaves the chord, reach with a free finger. Over F, finger 3 takes G on string 2, fret 3, then lifts as the tune comes back.

rows.source: Down by the Riverside, first printed in 1918, is made for singing together. On ukulele it sits in G, with G, C and D7, and a gospel A sharp on string 1, fret 1.
rows.translation: Down by the Riverside, fyrst prentað árið 1918, er gert fyrir samsöng. Á úkúlele er það í G, með G, C og D7 og gospelblæ á hækkuðu A á streng 1 í 1. bandi.

rows.source: Down by the riverside: B, B, A sharp, B, then A and G.
rows.translation: Down by the riverside: B, B, hækkað A, B, svo A og G.

rows.source: Cecil Sharp printed this English ballad in 1906. In F it uses F, B flat, C and C7, G minor and D minor, often two to a bar. Pick the chords between verses and let them ring.
rows.translation: Cecil Sharp prentaði þessa ensku ballödu árið 1906. Í F notar hún F, lækkað B, C og C7, G-moll og D-moll, oft tvo hljóma í takti. Plokkaðu hljómana milli erinda og láttu þá óma.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 10 · song uke-10-2 “The Water Is Wide” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: The water is wide: open string 3, F at fret 1 twice, G at fret 3, then open A.
rows.translation: The water is wide: opinn strengur 3, F í 1. bandi tvisvar, G í 3. bandi og svo opið A.

rows.source: Many bars here change halfway. Count the verse in two-beat halves, one chord each, and change on every other click.
rows.translation: Í mörgum töktum hér er skipt um miðjan takt. Teldu erindið í tveggja slaga helmingum, einn hljóm í hvorum, og skiptu á öðrum hverjum smelli.

rows.translation: Fyrir fyrsta yfirsláttinn telurðu upphátt á hraða lagsins: einn, tveir, þrír, fjórir. Allir byrja saman á hraðanum sem þú ákveður.

rows.source: Miss a chord? Keep strumming and catch the next one. A singing room follows the beat, not every note.
rows.translation: Misstirðu af hljómi? Haltu áfram að slá yfir og náðu þeim næsta. Syngjandi hópur fylgir púlsinum, ekki hverjum tóni.

rows.translation: Þú fiplast í hljómaskiptum í miðju lagi. Hvað nú?

rows.source: Keep strumming and catch the next chord

rows.translation: Hægðu á þar til þetta lagast
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 10 · lesson uke-10-3 “Lead the singalong” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: The beat carries everyone. Drop a chord if you must, never the rhythm.
rows.translation: Púlsinn ber alla áfram. Slepptu hljómi ef þú þarft, aldrei hrynjandinni.

rows.translation: Fyrir lokalínuna kinkarðu kolli eða kallar síðasta skipti. Hægðu örlítið á lokalínunni og láttu síðasta hljóminn óma.

rows.source: Molly Malone was printed in 1876. It's a waltz: lean on beat 1 and let the tune sway. In F it uses F, G minor, C7, D minor and G7.
rows.translation: Molly Malone var prentað árið 1876. Það er vals: leggðu þunga á slag 1 og leyfðu laglínunni að vagga. Í F notar það F, G-moll, C7, D-moll og G7.

rows.source: In Dublin's fair city: open string 3, F at fret 1 four times, open A, back to F.

rows.source: On beat 4, play a note one fret away from the next root. It pulls the ear forward, so the change feels like it arrives.
rows.translation: Á slagi 4 spilarðu tón einu bandi frá næsta grunntóni. Hann togar eyrað áfram svo skiptin finnist eins og lending.
rows.context: Bass · Unit 5 · lesson bass-5-3 “Chromatic approach notes” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: String 3 fret 4, then open string 2: one fret up into D.
rows.translation: Strengur 3 í 4. bandi, svo opinn strengur 2: eitt band upp í D.
rows.context: Bass · Unit 5 · lesson bass-5-3 “Chromatic approach notes” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: You're heading to D in the next bar. Which note on beat 4 pulls best?
rows.translation: Þú stefnir í D í næsta takti. Hvaða tónn á slagi 4 togar best?
rows.context: Bass · Unit 5 · lesson bass-5-3 “Chromatic approach notes” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: C sharp is one fret below D. A half step slides right into the new root.
rows.translation: Hækkað C er einu bandi neðan við D. Hálftónsskref rennur beint inn í nýja grunntóninn.
rows.context: Bass · Unit 5 · lesson bass-5-3 “Chromatic approach notes” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Gakktu inn í D og til baka
rows.context: Bass · Unit 5 · lesson bass-5-3 “Chromatic approach notes” · step 4 (along) · title

rows.translation: Eitt band á milli eða meira?

Bass · Unit 5 · lesson bass-5-3 “Chromatic approach notes” · step 5 (listen) · quiz answer

rows.source: Put the walk on the form
rows.context: Bass · Unit 5 · song bass-5-4 “Walking the blues in A” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Same 12 bars, now with a walking line. Bars that lead into a new chord end on an approach note.
rows.translation: Sömu 12 taktar, nú með gangandi bassalínu. Taktar sem leiða í nýjan hljóm enda á aðkomutóni.
rows.context: Bass · Unit 5 · song bass-5-4 “Walking the blues in A” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

Bass · Unit 5 · song bass-5-4 “Walking the blues in A” · step 4 (along) · title

rows.source: Why does bar 12 end on G sharp?
rows.translation: Af hverju endar taktur 12 á hækkuðu G?
rows.context: Bass · Unit 5 · song bass-5-4 “Walking the blues in A” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
Bass · Unit 5 · song bass-5-4 “Walking the blues in A” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: It leads back to A at the top
rows.translation: Það leiðir aftur í A í upphafi
rows.context: Bass · Unit 5 · song bass-5-4 “Walking the blues in A” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer
Bass · Unit 5 · song bass-5-4 “Walking the blues in A” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Bar 12 turns the form around. G sharp sits one fret below A, the chord that starts the next time through.
rows.translation: Taktur 12 snýr forminu við. Hækkað G er einu bandi neðan við A, hljóminn sem byrjar næstu umferð.
rows.context: Bass · Unit 5 · song bass-5-4 “Walking the blues in A” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

Bass · Unit 5 · challenge bass-5-5 “Challenge: walking blues in E” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: The 12-bar blues works in any key. In E the chords are E, A and B. Walk with roots, thirds, fifths and sixths, and approach each change.
rows.translation: 12 takta blúsinn virkar í hvaða tóntegund sem er. Í E eru hljómarnir E, A og B. Gakktu með grunntónum, þríundum, fimmundum og sexundum og notaðu aðkomutón fyrir hver skipti.
rows.context: Bass · Unit 5 · challenge bass-5-5 “Challenge: walking blues in E” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: In the key of E, which chord comes in bar 9?
rows.translation: Hvaða hljómur kemur í takti 9 í tóntegundinni E?
rows.context: Bass · Unit 5 · challenge bass-5-5 “Challenge: walking blues in E” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: String 3 fret 2; string 2 frets 1 and 4; string 1 fret 1.
rows.translation: Strengur 3 í 2. bandi; strengur 2 í böndum 1 og 4; strengur 1 í 1. bandi.
rows.context: Bass · Unit 5 · challenge bass-5-5 “Challenge: walking blues in E” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Eighth-note rock, dotted rhythms, space, and a Motown-style line.
rows.translation: Áttundapartsrokk, punkteruð hrynjandi, rými og bassalína í Motown-stíl.
rows.context: Bass · Unit 6 “Grooves” · unit summary

Bass · Unit 6 · lesson bass-6-1 “Eighth-note rock groove” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Count 1 and 2 and 3 and 4 and. Play a note on every count with your fingers taking turns. Even volume is the goal.
rows.translation: Teldu 1 og 2 og 3 og 4 og. Spilaðu tón á hverri talningu og láttu fingurna skiptast á. Markmiðið er jafn hljóðstyrkur.
rows.context: Bass · Unit 6 · lesson bass-6-1 “Eighth-note rock groove” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
Bass · Unit 6 · lesson bass-6-1 “Eighth-note rock groove” · step 3 (along) · title

rows.source: Your eighth notes start to rush. What helps?
rows.translation: Áttundapartsnóturnar byrja að flýta sér. Hvað hjálpar?
rows.context: Bass · Unit 6 · lesson bass-6-1 “Eighth-note rock groove” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
Bass · Unit 6 · lesson bass-6-1 “Eighth-note rock groove” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Lock to the click and relax your hand
rows.translation: Fylgja smellinum og slaka á hendinni
rows.context: Bass · Unit 6 · lesson bass-6-1 “Eighth-note rock groove” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Bass · Unit 6 · lesson bass-6-1 “Eighth-note rock groove” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: A dotted quarter lasts one and a half beats. Play on 1, hold through 2, then play on the and of 2, then on 3 and 4.
rows.translation: Punkteruð fjórðapartsnóta varir eitt og hálft slag. Spilaðu á 1, haltu yfir 2, spilaðu svo á og eftir 2 og síðan á 3 og 4.
rows.context: Bass · Unit 6 · lesson bass-6-2 “Dotted rhythms” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Long-short on A, D and E
rows.translation: Langt-stutt á A, D og E
rows.context: Bass · Unit 6 · lesson bass-6-2 “Dotted rhythms” · step 3 (along) · title

rows.source: Silence is part of the groove
rows.context: Bass · Unit 6 · lesson bass-6-3 “Leave some space” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Short notes with clean rests make a line bounce. Ease off the fretting finger, still touching the string, to stop each note right on time.
rows.translation: Stuttir tónar með hreinum þögnum láta línu skoppa. Slakaðu á gripfingrinum en haltu snertingu við strenginn til að stöðva hvern tón á réttum tíma.
rows.context: Bass · Unit 6 · lesson bass-6-3 “Leave some space” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: How do you stop a fretted note cleanly?
rows.context: Bass · Unit 6 · lesson bass-6-3 “Leave some space” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
Bass · Unit 6 · lesson bass-6-3 “Leave some space” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Bass · Unit 6 · lesson bass-6-3 “Leave some space” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Ease off but keep touching it
rows.context: Bass · Unit 6 · lesson bass-6-3 “Leave some space” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Release the pressure while your finger stays on the string. The note stops without a buzz.
rows.translation: Losaðu þrýstinginn meðan fingurinn helst á strengnum. Tónninn stöðvast án suðs.
rows.context: Bass · Unit 6 · lesson bass-6-3 “Leave some space” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
Bass · Unit 6 · lesson bass-6-4 “A Motown-style line” · title

rows.source: Busy, but always in the pocket
rows.translation: Mikið á ferð, en alltaf í rétta púlsinum
rows.context: Bass · Unit 6 · lesson bass-6-4 “A Motown-style line” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Motown-era bass lines moved a lot: chord tones, notes that lean into the next chord, and pushes off the beat. This line is new, written in that spirit.
rows.translation: Bassalínur Motown-tímans voru mikið á hreyfingu: hljómtónar, tónar sem halla sér inn í næsta hljóm og áherslur milli slaga. Þessi lína er ný, samin í þeim anda.
rows.context: Bass · Unit 6 · lesson bass-6-4 “A Motown-style line” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: The first bar: C, E, G, then B flat leaning into A.
rows.translation: Fyrsti takturinn: C, E, G og svo lækkað B sem hallar sér inn í A.
rows.context: Bass · Unit 6 · lesson bass-6-4 “A Motown-style line” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
Bass · Unit 6 · lesson bass-6-4 “A Motown-style line” · step 6 (along) · title

rows.source: What does B flat do at the end of bar 1?
rows.translation: Hvað gerir lækkað B í lok takts 1?
rows.context: Bass · Unit 6 · lesson bass-6-4 “A Motown-style line” · step 7 (quiz) · question or instruction
Bass · Unit 6 · lesson bass-6-4 “A Motown-style line” · step 7 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Leads down a fret into A
rows.translation: Leiðir niður um eitt band í A
rows.context: Bass · Unit 6 · lesson bass-6-4 “A Motown-style line” · step 7 (quiz) · quiz answer
Bass · Unit 6 · lesson bass-6-4 “A Motown-style line” · step 7 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: It's an approach note, one fret above A, the root of the next chord. It slides you into the next bar.
rows.translation: Það er aðkomutónn, einu bandi ofan við A, grunntón næsta hljóms. Hann rennir þér inn í næsta takt.
rows.context: Bass · Unit 6 · lesson bass-6-4 “A Motown-style line” · step 7 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

Bass · Unit 6 · challenge bass-6-5 “Challenge: groove set” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Eighth notes, dotted rhythms and a moving line. Stay with the click, keep your fingers taking turns and enjoy the groove.
rows.translation: Áttundapartsnótur, punkteruð hrynjandi og hreyfanleg lína. Fylgdu smellinum, láttu fingurna skiptast á og njóttu hrynjandinnar.
rows.context: Bass · Unit 6 · challenge bass-6-5 “Challenge: groove set” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: In an eighth-note groove, which counts get a note?
rows.translation: Hvaða talningar fá tón í áttundapartsnótnahrynjandi?

Violin course · title

rows.source: Bow, finger and play in tune, from open strings to fiddle tunes
rows.translation: Bogastrok, fingrasetning og hreinir tónar, frá opnum strengjum að þjóðlögum
rows.context: Violin course · course subtitle
Violin · Unit 1 “Hello, violin” · title

rows.source: Hold it, bow it, tune it, play the open strings and your first song.
rows.translation: Haltu á henni, strjúktu, stilltu, spilaðu opnu strengina og fyrsta lagið þitt.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 “Hello, violin” · unit summary
Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-1 “Meet your violin” · title

rows.translation: Fjórir strengir, frá lágum til hárra
rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-1 “Meet your violin” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: With the violin under your chin, the strings run G, D, A, E from left to right. G is the thickest and lowest. E is the thinnest and highest, and we call it string 1.
rows.translation: Með fiðluna undir hökunni liggja strengirnir G, D, A, E frá vinstri til hægri. G er þykkastur og lægstur. E er þynnstur og hæstur og við köllum hann streng 1.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-1 “Meet your violin” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-1 “Meet your violin” · step 2 (explain) · title

rows.source: The bridge is the thin wooden arch that holds the strings up. String pressure alone keeps it standing. If it starts to lean, ask a teacher or shop to set it straight.
rows.translation: Stóllinn er þunni viðarboginn sem heldur strengjunum uppi. Strengjaþrýstingurinn einn heldur honum uppréttum. Ef hann byrjar að hallast skaltu biðja kennara eða hljóðfæraverslun að rétta hann.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-1 “Meet your violin” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text
Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-1 “Meet your violin” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: E is the thinnest string and the highest. Strings count from E (1) to G (4).
rows.translation: E er þynnsti strengurinn og sá hæsti. Strengirnir eru taldir frá E (1) til G (4).
rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-1 “Meet your violin” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-1 “Meet your violin” · step 4 (explain) · title

rows.source: Before you use the bow, pluck. Rest your right thumb against the side of the fingerboard and pull the string with your first finger. Players call this pizzicato.
rows.translation: Plokkaðu áður en þú notar bogann. Láttu hægri þumalinn hvíla við hlið gripbrettisins og togaðu í strenginn með fyrsta fingri. Hljóðfæraleikarar kalla þetta pizzicato.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-1 “Meet your violin” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Rest the violin on your lap like a small guitar. Pluck string 2, the A, and let it ring.
rows.translation: Láttu fiðluna hvíla í kjöltunni eins og lítinn gítar. Plokkaðu streng 2, A, og láttu hann óma.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-1 “Meet your violin” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise
Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-1 “Meet your violin” · step 6 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Now the thickest string, the G.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-1 “Meet your violin” · step 7 (notes) · hint under an exercise
Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-2 “Hold the violin” · title
Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-2 “Hold the violin” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Set the violin's lower edge on your left collarbone and turn your head to rest your jaw on the chin rest. The weight of your head holds it. No clamping.
rows.translation: Settu neðri brún fiðlunnar á vinstra viðbeinið og snúðu höfðinu svo kjálkinn hvíli á hökustykkinu. Þyngd höfuðsins heldur henni. Ekki klemma.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-2 “Hold the violin” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-2 “Hold the violin” · step 2 (explain) · title

rows.source: Point the scroll forward and to your left, about level with the floor. Your left hand cradles the neck, thumb across from your first finger. Keep the wrist straight and soft.
rows.translation: Láttu snigilinn vísa fram og til vinstri, nokkurn veginn lárétt. Vinstri höndin styður hálsinn, með þumalinn á móti fyrsta fingri. Hafðu úlnliðinn beinan og mjúkan.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-2 “Hold the violin” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text
Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-2 “Hold the violin” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Your collarbone and the weight of your head
rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-2 “Hold the violin” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-2 “Hold the violin” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-2 “Hold the violin” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Let your head rest on the chin rest. A squeezing hand or a raised shoulder makes you tense, and tension pulls notes out of tune.
rows.translation: Láttu höfuðið hvíla á hökustykkinu. Klemmandi hönd eða upplyft öxl spennir þig og spenna dregur tónana úr réttri tónhæð.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-2 “Hold the violin” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Hold the violin in place and pluck the D string, string 3.
rows.translation: Haltu fiðlunni á sínum stað og plokkaðu D-strenginn, streng 3.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-2 “Hold the violin” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise
Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-2 “Hold the violin” · step 6 (along) · title
Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-3 “Hold the bow” · title
Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-3 “Hold the bow” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: The wooden stick runs from the frog, where you hold it, to the tip. Horsehair stretches between them. Tighten the screw until a pencil just fits between hair and stick.
rows.translation: Viðarstafurinn liggur frá froskinum, þar sem þú heldur, að oddinum. Hrossatagl er strekkt á milli. Hertu skrúfuna þar til blýantur kemst rétt á milli tagls og stafs.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-3 “Hold the bow” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-3 “Hold the bow” · step 2 (explain) · title

rows.source: Bend your thumb and set its tip where the frog meets the stick. Drape your fingers over the stick, with your little finger standing curved on top. Keep the whole hand soft.
rows.translation: Beygðu þumalinn og settu góminn þar sem froskurinn mætir stafnum. Leggðu fingurna yfir stafinn, með boginn litlafingur ofan á. Hafðu alla höndina mjúka.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-3 “Hold the bow” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text
Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-3 “Hold the bow” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Bent, where the frog meets the stick
rows.translation: Boginn, þar sem froskur mætir staf
rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-3 “Hold the bow” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-3 “Hold the bow” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Flat on top of the stick
rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-3 “Hold the bow” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: A bent thumb at the frog lets the hand stay soft and balance the bow.
rows.translation: Boginn þumall við froskinn leyfir hendinni að vera mjúk og halda boganum í jafnvægi.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-3 “Hold the bow” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-3 “Hold the bow” · step 4 (explain) · title

rows.source: Bare hair slides over the string without a sound. Rub the cake of rosin along the hair a few times before you play. A light coat is enough.
rows.translation: Ómeðhöndlað tagl rennur yfir strenginn án hljóðs. Strjúktu harpixkubbi nokkrum sinnum eftir taglinu áður en þú spilar. Þunnt lag er nóg.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-3 “Hold the bow” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Set the bow on the A string, halfway between bridge and fingerboard. Pull it slowly to the right.
rows.translation: Settu bogann á A-strenginn, mitt á milli stóls og gripbrettis. Dragðu hann hægt til hægri.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-3 “Hold the bow” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Now the D string. Lift your elbow a little, then pull slowly.
rows.translation: Nú D-strenginn. Lyftu olnboganum aðeins og dragðu svo hægt.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-3 “Hold the bow” · step 6 (notes) · hint under an exercise
Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-3 “Hold the bow” · step 7 (along) · title

rows.source: From low to high: G, D, A, E. Each string is five letter names above the last, an interval called a fifth. Try: Good Dogs Always Eat.
rows.translation: Frá lágum til hárra: G, D, A, E. Hver strengur er fimm bókstafsheitum ofan við þann fyrri, tónbil sem kallast fimmund. Prófaðu: Góðir dagar auka einbeitingu.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-4 “The open strings” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-4 “The open strings” · step 2 (explain) · title

rows.source: Your right elbow sets which string the bow plays. Raise it for G, lower it for E. Each string has its own level, like the steps of a stair.
rows.translation: Hægri olnboginn ræður hvaða streng boginn spilar. Lyftu honum fyrir G, lækkaðu hann fyrir E. Hver strengur hefur sína hæð, eins og þrep í stiga.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-4 “The open strings” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Bow the G string, then D. Your elbow is highest for G.
rows.translation: Strjúktu G-strenginn og svo D. Olnboginn er hæstur fyrir G.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-4 “The open strings” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Now A, then E. Lower your elbow one step for each.
rows.translation: Nú A og svo E. Lækkaðu olnbogann um eitt þrep fyrir hvorn.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-4 “The open strings” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Which string needs the highest elbow?
rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-4 “The open strings” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: The G string sits farthest to the left, so your arm lifts to reach it. E needs the lowest arm.
rows.translation: G-strengurinn er lengst til vinstri, svo handleggurinn lyftist til að ná honum. E þarf lægsta handlegginn.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-4 “The open strings” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-5 “Tune your violin” · title
Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-5 “Tune your violin” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Orchestras tune to A. Timbre shows how far each string is from its note in cents; 100 cents make a half step, the smallest step on a piano. Tune A, then D, G and E.
rows.translation: Sinfóníuhljómsveitir stilla eftir A. Timbre sýnir í sentum hversu langt hver strengur er frá tóninum sínum; 100 sent mynda hálftónsskref, minnsta skref á píanói. Stilltu A, svo D, G og E.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-5 “Tune your violin” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-5 “Tune your violin” · step 2 (explain) · title

rows.source: The small screws on the tailpiece are fine tuners. Turn one clockwise to raise the pitch, counterclockwise to lower it. Quarter turns are plenty.
rows.translation: Litlu skrúfurnar á strengjahaldaranum eru fínstillar. Snúðu réttsælis til að hækka tóninn, rangsælis til að lækka hann. Fjórðungs snúningar duga vel.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-5 “Tune your violin” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: A string is a little flat. What do you do?
rows.translation: Strengur er aðeins of lágur. Hvað gerirðu?
rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-5 “Tune your violin” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-5 “Tune your violin” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-5 “Tune your violin” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-5 “Tune your violin” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Flat means too low. Clockwise tightens the string and raises the pitch.
rows.translation: Of lágt merkir að tónhæðin er of lág. Réttsælis snúningur herðir strenginn og hækkar tóninn.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-5 “Tune your violin” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-5 “Tune your violin” · step 4 (explain) · title

rows.source: If a fine tuner runs out of room, use the peg. Turn it a little while pushing it inward so it holds. If a string is far off, ask a teacher; pegs can slip.
rows.translation: Ef fínstillirinn nær ekki lengra notarðu stilliskrúfuna. Snúðu henni aðeins um leið og þú ýtir henni inn svo hún haldi. Ef strengur er langt frá réttri tónhæð skaltu biðja kennara um hjálp; skrúfur geta runnið til.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-5 “Tune your violin” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Tune your A string, then bow it and hold it steady.
rows.translation: Stilltu A-strenginn, strjúktu hann svo með boganum og haltu tóninum stöðugum.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-5 “Tune your violin” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Now D, G and E. Tune each one, then bow it and hold it.
rows.translation: Nú D, G og E. Stilltu hvern streng, strjúktu hann svo og haltu tóninum.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-5 “Tune your violin” · step 6 (notes) · hint under an exercise
Violin · Unit 1 · challenge vln-1-6 “Open-string checkup” · title
Violin · Unit 1 · challenge vln-1-6 “Open-string checkup” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Violin on your collarbone, soft bow hold, bow halfway between bridge and fingerboard. Now play everything from this unit.
rows.translation: Fiðlan á viðbeininu, mjúkt bogagrip, boginn mitt á milli stóls og gripbrettis. Spilaðu nú allt úr þessari einingu.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · challenge vln-1-6 “Open-string checkup” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
Violin · Unit 1 · challenge vln-1-6 “Open-string checkup” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Bow each open string from high to low. Hold each one steady.
rows.translation: Strjúktu hvern opinn streng frá háum til lágra. Haltu hverjum tón stöðugum.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · challenge vln-1-6 “Open-string checkup” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Which string do you tune first?
rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · challenge vln-1-6 “Open-string checkup” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Orchestras tune to A, so start there and tune the others after it.
rows.translation: Sinfóníuhljómsveitir stilla eftir A, svo byrjaðu þar og stilltu hina á eftir.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · challenge vln-1-6 “Open-string checkup” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
Violin · Unit 1 · challenge vln-1-6 “Open-string checkup” · step 6 (along) · title

rows.source: Mary Had a Little Lamb lives on the A string: open A, first finger a whole step up for B, second finger another whole step up for C sharp. Pluck it first, then bow it.
rows.translation: Mary Had a Little Lamb býr á A-strengnum: opið A, fyrsti fingur heiltónsskrefi ofar fyrir B, annar fingur öðru heiltónsskrefi ofar fyrir hækkað C. Plokkaðu fyrst og notaðu svo bogann.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · song vln-1-7 “Mary Had a Little Lamb” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: First finger on the A string, a whole step up. That's B.
rows.translation: Fyrsti fingur á A-strengnum, heiltónsskrefi ofar. Það er B.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · song vln-1-7 “Mary Had a Little Lamb” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Second finger a whole step above your first. That's C sharp.
rows.translation: Annar fingur heiltónsskrefi ofan við þann fyrsta. Það er hækkað C.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · song vln-1-7 “Mary Had a Little Lamb” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: C sharp, B, A, B, then C sharp three times.
rows.translation: Hækkað C, B, A, B og svo hækkað C þrisvar.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · song vln-1-7 “Mary Had a Little Lamb” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise
Violin · Unit 2 “Bowing” · title

rows.source: Long, even bows, clean string crossings and your first rhythms.
rows.translation: Löng, jöfn bogastrok, hrein strengjaskipti og fyrstu hrynjandimynstrin þín.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 2 “Bowing” · unit summary
Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-1 “Down-bow, up-bow” · title
Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-1 “Down-bow, up-bow” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: A down-bow pulls the bow to the right, from frog to tip. An up-bow pushes it back to the left. In music, a down-bow mark looks like a little table and an up-bow like a V.
rows.translation: Niðurstrok dregur bogann til hægri, frá froski að oddi. Uppstrok ýtir honum aftur til vinstri. Í nótum lítur niðurstroksmerki út eins og lítið borð og uppstroksmerki eins og V.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-1 “Down-bow, up-bow” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Which way does a down-bow move?
rows.context: Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-1 “Down-bow, up-bow” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction
Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-1 “Down-bow, up-bow” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer

Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-1 “Down-bow, up-bow” · step 3 (explain) · title

rows.source: Play halfway between the bridge and the end of the fingerboard. Keep the bow parallel to the bridge, like a train on its track.
rows.translation: Spilaðu mitt á milli stólsins og enda gripbrettisins. Hafðu bogann samsíða stólnum, eins og lest á teinum.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-1 “Down-bow, up-bow” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: One slow down-bow, then one slow up-bow on A. Keep the sound even to the end.
rows.translation: Eitt hægt niðurstrok og svo eitt hægt uppstrok á A. Haltu hljóðinu jöfnu til enda.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-1 “Down-bow, up-bow” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise
Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-1 “Down-bow, up-bow” · step 5 (along) · title
Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-1 “Down-bow, up-bow” · step 6 (along) · title

Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-2 “Quarter notes, half notes” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: A quarter note lasts one beat. Quick notes need less bow, so use the middle half of the bow and keep every stroke the same length.
rows.translation: Fjórðapartsnóta varir eitt slag. Snöggir tónar þurfa minni boga, svo notaðu miðjuhelming bogans og hafðu öll strok jafn löng.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-2 “Quarter notes, half notes” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-2 “Quarter notes, half notes” · step 3 (along) · title
Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-2 “Quarter notes, half notes” · step 4 (explain) · title

rows.source: A half note lasts two beats. Use a longer, slower bow so the sound doesn't fade on the second beat.
rows.translation: Hálfnóta varir tvö slög. Notaðu lengra, hægara bogastrok svo hljóðið dofni ekki á öðru slaginu.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-2 “Quarter notes, half notes” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text
Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-2 “Quarter notes, half notes” · step 6 (quiz) · question or instruction
Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-2 “Quarter notes, half notes” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer
Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-2 “Quarter notes, half notes” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer
Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-2 “Quarter notes, half notes” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: A half note lasts twice as long, so it gets a longer, slower stroke.
rows.translation: Hálfnóta varir tvöfalt lengur, svo hún fær lengra, hægara strok.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-2 “Quarter notes, half notes” · step 6 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-2 “Quarter notes, half notes” · step 7 (along) · title
Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-3 “String crossings” · title
Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-3 “String crossings” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: To cross strings, change levels with your elbow, not your wrist. Arrive at the new level just before the bow changes direction.
rows.translation: Til að skipta um streng breytirðu hæðinni með olnboganum, ekki úlnliðnum. Náðu nýju hæðinni rétt áður en boginn skiptir um átt.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-3 “String crossings” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: A, E, A, E. Let your elbow rock between the two levels.
rows.translation: A, E, A, E. Láttu olnbogann vagga milli hæðanna tveggja.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-3 “String crossings” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-3 “String crossings” · step 3 (along) · title

rows.source: What moves the bow to a new string?
rows.translation: Hvað færir bogann á nýjan streng?
rows.context: Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-3 “String crossings” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-3 “String crossings” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-3 “String crossings” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-3 “String crossings” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-3 “String crossings” · step 5 (explain) · title

rows.source: Going from G to A skips the D string, so your elbow makes a bigger move. Travel smoothly and don't let the middle string sound.
rows.translation: Að fara frá G í A hoppar yfir D-strenginn, svo olnboginn hreyfist meira. Færðu hann mjúklega og láttu ekki miðstrenginn hljóma.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-3 “String crossings” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Allir fjórir, upp og til baka
rows.context: Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-3 “String crossings” · step 6 (along) · title
Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-4 “Eighth notes” · title
Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-4 “Eighth notes” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: An eighth note lasts half a beat, so two fit in each beat. Use small, quick bows near the middle of the bow.
rows.translation: Áttundapartsnóta varir hálft slag, svo tvær komast í hvert slag. Notaðu lítil, snögg strok nálægt miðjum boganum.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-4 “Eighth notes” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-4 “Eighth notes” · step 3 (along) · title

rows.source: How many eighth notes fit in one beat?
rows.translation: Hversu margar áttundapartsnótur komast í eitt slag?
rows.context: Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-4 “Eighth notes” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-4 “Eighth notes” · step 5 (explain) · title

rows.source: Now mix them: a quarter, two eighths, then two quarters. Fiddlers lean on this rhythm. Say it first: long, short-short, long, long.
rows.translation: Blandaðu þeim nú saman: fjórðapartsnóta, tvær áttundapartsnótur og svo tvær fjórðapartsnótur. Þjóðlagafiðlarar nota þessa hrynjandi mikið. Segðu hana fyrst: langt, stutt-stutt, langt, langt.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-4 “Eighth notes” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text
Violin · Unit 2 · challenge vln-2-5 “Bowing checkup” · title
Violin · Unit 2 · challenge vln-2-5 “Bowing checkup” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Straight bows at the contact point, crossings led by the elbow, and steady rhythms. Here's a mix of all three.
rows.translation: Bein bogastrok við snertipunktinn, strengjaskipti leidd af olnboganum og jöfn hrynjandi. Hér er blanda af öllu þrennu.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 2 · challenge vln-2-5 “Bowing checkup” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
Violin · Unit 2 · challenge vln-2-5 “Bowing checkup” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Mitt á milli stóls og gripbrettis
rows.context: Violin · Unit 2 · challenge vln-2-5 “Bowing checkup” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Right on top of the bridge
rows.context: Violin · Unit 2 · challenge vln-2-5 “Bowing checkup” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Over the end of the fingerboard
rows.context: Violin · Unit 2 · challenge vln-2-5 “Bowing checkup” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Violin · Unit 2 · challenge vln-2-5 “Bowing checkup” · step 4 (along) · title

Violin · Unit 2 · challenge vln-2-5 “Bowing checkup” · step 6 (along) · title
Violin · Unit 3 “First fingers: A and E” · title

rows.source: Place fingers 1, 2 and 3, play the A major scale and your first song.
rows.translation: Settu fingur 1, 2 og 3 niður, spilaðu A-dúrtónstigann og fyrsta lagið þitt.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 3 “First fingers: A and E” · unit summary
Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-1 “First finger: B” · title
Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-1 “First finger: B” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Your instrument has no frets, so your ear places every note. Many players stick thin tapes on the fingerboard as a guide while they learn.
rows.translation: Hljóðfærið hefur engin bönd, svo eyrað staðsetur hvern tón. Margir líma þunnar límræmur á gripbrettið sér til leiðsagnar meðan þeir læra.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-1 “First finger: B” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-1 “First finger: B” · step 2 (explain) · title

rows.source: Put your first fingertip on the A string at the first tape. That's B, a whole step above A; a whole step is two half steps. Press until the string meets the fingerboard.
rows.translation: Settu fyrsta fingurgóminn á A-strenginn við fyrstu límræmuna. Það er B, heiltónsskrefi ofan við A; heiltónsskref er tvö hálftónsskref. Þrýstu þar til strengurinn snertir gripbrettið.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-1 “First finger: B” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Open A, then B with your first finger. Hold B until it settles in tune.
rows.translation: Opið A og svo B með fyrsta fingri. Haltu B þar til tónhæðin verður rétt.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-1 “First finger: B” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.translation: Of hátt eða lágt? Færðu fingurinn
rows.context: Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-1 “First finger: B” · step 4 (explain) · title

rows.source: Timbre accepts a note within 30 cents, about a third of a half step. If you're sharp, nudge the finger toward the scroll. If you're flat, nudge it toward the bridge.
rows.translation: Timbre samþykkir tón innan 30 senta, um þriðjungs úr hálftónsskrefi. Ef tónninn er of hár færirðu fingurinn aðeins að sniglinum. Ef hann er of lágur færirðu hann að stólnum.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-1 “First finger: B” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: B, open A, B. Lift the finger and set it down in the same spot.
rows.translation: B, opið A, B. Lyftu fingrinum og settu hann aftur á sama stað.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-1 “First finger: B” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Open A, then B. How far apart?
rows.translation: Opið A og svo B. Hversu langt er á milli?
rows.context: Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-1 “First finger: B” · step 6 (listen) · question or instruction
Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-1 “First finger: B” · step 6 (listen) · quiz answer
Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-1 “First finger: B” · step 6 (listen) · quiz answer
Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-1 “First finger: B” · step 7 (along) · title
Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-2 “Second finger: C sharp” · title
Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-2 “Second finger: C sharp” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Second finger plays C sharp, a whole step above B, so leave a gap after first finger. This spot is called high 2, because it sits close to where third finger will go.
rows.translation: Annar fingur spilar hækkað C, heiltónsskrefi ofan við B, svo skildu eftir bil frá fyrsta fingri. Þessi staður kallast hátt 2, því hann er nálægt því þar sem þriðji fingur mun fara.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-2 “Second finger: C sharp” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: A, B, C sharp. Keep first finger down while second plays.
rows.translation: A, B, hækkað C. Haltu fyrsta fingri niðri meðan annar spilar.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-2 “Second finger: C sharp” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: From B to the next note: what kind of step?
rows.translation: Frá B að næsta tóni: hvers konar skref?
rows.context: Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-2 “Second finger: C sharp” · step 3 (listen) · question or instruction

rows.source: How far is C sharp above B?
rows.translation: Hversu langt er hækkað C ofan við B?
rows.context: Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-2 “Second finger: C sharp” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-2 “Second finger: C sharp” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: B to C sharp is two half steps, so second finger leaves a gap after first.
rows.translation: Frá B í hækkað C eru tvö hálftónsskref, svo annar fingur skilur eftir bil frá þeim fyrsta.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-2 “Second finger: C sharp” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: B, C sharp, B, A. Land each note in tune before you move on.
rows.translation: B, hækkað C, B, A. Lentu á réttri tónhæð í hverjum tóni áður en þú heldur áfram.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-2 “Second finger: C sharp” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise
Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-3 “Third finger: D” · title
Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-3 “Third finger: D” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Third finger plays D, a half step above C sharp, so it sits right against second finger. On the A string the pattern is 1, then 2 and 3 together.
rows.translation: Þriðji fingur spilar D, hálftónsskrefi ofan við hækkað C, svo hann liggur alveg við annan fingur. Á A-strengnum er mynstrið 1, svo 2 og 3 saman.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-3 “Third finger: D” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: A, B, C sharp, D. Leave each finger down as you add the next.
rows.translation: A, B, hækkað C, D. Haltu hverjum fingri niðri þegar þú bætir þeim næsta við.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-3 “Third finger: D” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-3 “Third finger: D” · step 3 (explain) · title

rows.source: When your D is in tune, the open D string vibrates along with it. The two share a letter name, eight notes apart: an octave. Listen for the violin sounding fuller.
rows.translation: Þegar D er á réttri tónhæð titrar opni D-strengurinn með því. Þeir deila bókstafsheiti, með átta tóna bili: áttund. Hlustaðu eftir fyllri fiðluhljómi.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-3 “Third finger: D” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Third-finger D, open D, then third-finger D again. Listen for the ring.
rows.translation: D með þriðja fingri, opið D og svo D með þriðja fingri aftur. Hlustaðu eftir samómuninni.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-3 “Third finger: D” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise

Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-3 “Third finger: D” · step 5 (listen) · quiz answer
Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-3 “Third finger: D” · step 5 (listen) · quiz answer

rows.source: Which fingers touch on the A string?
rows.context: Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-3 “Third finger: D” · step 6 (quiz) · question or instruction
Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-3 “Third finger: D” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer
Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-3 “Third finger: D” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer
Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-3 “Third finger: D” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: B to C sharp is a whole step, so 1 and 2 have a gap. C sharp to D is a half step, so 2 and 3 touch.
rows.translation: Frá B í hækkað C er heiltónsskref, svo bil er milli 1 og 2. Frá hækkuðu C í D er hálftónsskref, svo 2 og 3 snertast.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-3 “Third finger: D” · step 6 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-3 “Third finger: D” · step 7 (along) · title
Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-4 “The E string” · title

rows.source: On the E string, first finger plays F sharp, high second G sharp, and third A. It's the A-string shape, one string higher. Lower your bow arm to the E level.
rows.translation: Á E-strengnum spilar fyrsti fingur hækkað F, hár annar fingur hækkað G og þriðji A. Þetta er A-strengsgripið, einum streng ofar. Lækkaðu bogahandlegginn í E-hæðina.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-4 “The E string” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: E, F sharp, G sharp, A. Same shape as on the A string.
rows.translation: E, hækkað F, hækkað G, A. Sama grip og á A-strengnum.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 3 · lesson vln-3-4 “The E string” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Your third finger on E plays A. What can you check it against?

rows.translation: Tengdu helmingana: A, B, hækkað C, D á A-strengnum og svo E, hækkað F, hækkað G, A á E-strengnum. Átta tónar, A til A, eitt grip spilað tvisvar.

rows.source: Up the A major scale, slowly. Cross to E for the top four notes.

rows.source: Whole step, whole step, half step: that's the pattern on A and E. Land each note in tune and let the open strings ring with you.
rows.translation: Heiltónsskref, heiltónsskref, hálftónsskref: þannig er mynstrið á A og E. Lentu á réttri tónhæð í hverjum tóni og láttu opnu strengina óma með þér.

rows.source: On the D string, first finger plays E, high second F sharp, and third G. It's the A-string pattern, one string lower. Raise your bow arm a step.
rows.translation: Á D-strengnum spilar fyrsti fingur E, hár annar fingur hækkað F og þriðji G. Þetta er A-strengsmynstrið, einum streng neðar. Lyftu bogahandleggnum um eitt þrep.

rows.source: D, E, F sharp, G. Second and third fingers touch.

rows.source: Third-finger G on the D string is an octave above the open G string. When it's in tune, the G string hums along.
rows.translation: G með þriðja fingri á D-strengnum er áttund ofan við opna G-strenginn. Þegar það er á réttri tónhæð ómar G-strengurinn með.

rows.source: Third-finger G, open G, third-finger G. Listen for the ring.
rows.translation: G með þriðja fingri, opið G, G með þriðja fingri. Hlustaðu eftir samómuninni.

rows.translation: Þetta er aftur A-strengsmynstrið: heiltónsskref, heiltónsskref, hálftónsskref. Hálftónsskrefið er milli 2 og 3.

rows.translation: Spilaðu D, E, hækkað F, G á D-strengnum og svo A, B, hækkað C, D á A-strengnum. D-dúrtónstiginn er eitt fingragrip spilað tvisvar.

rows.source: On the G string, first finger plays A, high second B, and third C. Same shape again. Raise your bow arm to its highest level.
rows.translation: Á G-strengnum spilar fyrsti fingur A, hár annar fingur B og þriðji C. Aftur sama grip. Lyftu bogahandleggnum í hæstu stöðu.

rows.source: G, A, B, C. Swing your left elbow a little under the violin to reach.

rows.source: First-finger A on the G string, then the open A string. Same letter, an octave apart.

rows.source: G, A, B, C on the G string plus D, E, F sharp, G on the D string make G major. It's the first octave of a two-octave scale you'll finish in the next unit.
rows.translation: G, A, B, C á G-strengnum ásamt D, E, hækkuðu F, G á D-strengnum mynda G-dúr. Þetta er fyrri áttund tveggja áttunda tónstiga sem þú klárar í næstu einingu.

rows.translation: Upp G-dúrtónstigann. Sama grip á báðum strengjum.

rows.source: Beethoven wrote this tune for his Ninth Symphony in 1824. It moves mostly by step, so your fingers walk.
rows.translation: Beethoven samdi þetta lag fyrir níundu sinfóníu sína árið 1824. Það færist að mestu í skrefum, svo fingurnir ganga.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 4 · song vln-4-5 “Ode to Joy” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Each line ends long, short, long: a dotted quarter, an eighth and a half note. A dot after a note adds half its length.
rows.translation: Hver lína endar langt, stutt, langt: punkteruð fjórðapartsnóta, áttundapartsnóta og hálfnóta. Punktur á eftir nótu bætir við helmingi lengdar hennar.

rows.source: This old American fiddle tune rides the rhythm you bowed on open strings: long, short-short, long, long. Fiddlers play it at jams everywhere.
rows.translation: Þetta gamla bandaríska fiðlulag ríður hrynjandinni sem þú lékst með boganum á opnum strengjum: langt, stutt-stutt, langt, langt. Fiðlarar spila það á samspilsstundum út um allt.

rows.source: Which string does this tune never use?
rows.translation: Hvaða streng notar þetta lag aldrei?

rows.source: A, B, C, D. Second finger touches first; leave a gap before third.
rows.translation: A, B, C, D. Annar fingur snertir þann fyrsta; skildu eftir bil fyrir þann þriðja.

rows.source: G major needs C natural on the A string and G natural on the E string, so second finger sits low there. On the G and D strings it stays high.
rows.translation: G-dúr þarf óhækkað C á A-strengnum og óhækkað G á E-strengnum, svo annar fingur er lágur þar. Á G- og D-strengjunum helst hann hár.

rows.source: Now E, F sharp, G on the E string. Low 2 again.
rows.translation: Nú E, hækkað F, G á E-strengnum. Aftur lágt 2.

rows.translation: A til C hljómar dökkt; A til hækkaðs C hljómar bjart. Eitt hálftónsskref breytir allri stemningunni.

rows.translation: Þessi menúett kemur úr nótnabókinni sem Bach gaf eiginkonu sinni Önnu Magdalenu árið 1725. Hann er nú eignaður Christian Petzold. Teldu þrjú slög í takti.

rows.source: The minuet is in G major, so C is natural and second finger sits low on the A string.
rows.translation: Menúettinn er í G-dúr, svo C er óhækkað og annar fingur liggur lágt á A-strengnum.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 5 · song vln-5-4 “Minuet in G” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: F sharp is high 2 on the D string: low on A, high on D.
rows.translation: Hækkað F er hátt 2 á D-strengnum: lágt á A, hátt á D.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 5 · song vln-5-4 “Minuet in G” · step 6 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: The second half starts high: fourth finger reaches B on the E string. Then third, then low 2.
rows.translation: Seinni helmingurinn byrjar hátt: fjórði fingur nær B á E-strengnum. Svo þriðji og síðan lágt 2.

rows.source: Old Joe Clark is an Appalachian fiddle tune. It's in A but uses G natural: high 2 for C sharp on the A string, low 2 for G on the E string.
rows.translation: Old Joe Clark er fiðlulag frá Appalachiafjöllum. Það er í A en notar óhækkað G: hátt 2 fyrir hækkað C á A-strengnum, lágt 2 fyrir G á E-strengnum.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 5 · song vln-5-5 “Old Joe Clark” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: E, F sharp, G, F sharp. Keep second finger low, touching first.
rows.translation: E, hækkað F, G, hækkað F. Haltu öðrum fingri lágt, við þann fyrsta.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 5 · song vln-5-5 “Old Joe Clark” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Which G does this tune use on the E string?
rows.translation: Hvaða G notar þetta lag á E-strengnum?
rows.context: Violin · Unit 5 · song vln-5-5 “Old Joe Clark” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: G natural instead of G sharp gives Old Joe Clark its old-time sound.
rows.translation: Óhækkað G í stað hækkaðs G gefur Old Joe Clark gamaldags hljóminn sinn.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 5 · song vln-5-5 “Old Joe Clark” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
Violin · Unit 5 · song vln-5-6 “Soldier's Joy” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Soldier's Joy was printed in Scotland in the 1700s and is still played at dances across America. Its first part rocks on A, F sharp and D, the notes of a D major chord.
rows.translation: Soldier's Joy var prentað í Skotlandi á öldinni sem hófst árið 1700 og er enn spilað á dansleikjum víða um Bandaríkin. Fyrri hlutinn vaggar á A, hækkuðu F og D, tónum D-dúrhljóms.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 5 · song vln-5-6 “Soldier's Joy” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Open A, high-2 F sharp on D, open D, F sharp. Rock your elbow between strings.
rows.translation: Opið A, hækkað F með háu 2 á D, opið D, hækkað F. Vaggaðu olnboganum milli strengja.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 5 · song vln-5-6 “Soldier's Joy” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Which finger plays G on the E string?
rows.translation: Hvaða fingur spilar G á E-strengnum?
rows.context: Violin · Unit 5 · song vln-5-6 “Soldier's Joy” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Soldier's Joy is in D major, so G is natural: high 2 for F sharp on D, low 2 for G on E.
rows.translation: Soldier's Joy er í D-dúr, svo G er óhækkað: hátt 2 fyrir hækkað F á D, lágt 2 fyrir G á E.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 5 · song vln-5-6 “Soldier's Joy” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Every key sets your second finger. Before you play, ask: high 2 or low 2, and on which string?
rows.translation: Hver tóntegund staðsetur annan fingur. Áður en þú spilar spyrðu: hátt 2 eða lágt 2 og á hvaða streng?
rows.context: Violin · Unit 5 · challenge vln-5-7 “Second finger checkup” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: F sharp, then high 2 or low 2?
rows.translation: Hækkað F og svo hátt 2 eða lágt 2?
rows.context: Violin · Unit 5 · challenge vln-5-7 “Second finger checkup” · step 2 (listen) · question or instruction

rows.source: Low 2 and high 2 on the A string, then low 2 and high 2 on the E string.
rows.translation: Lágt 2 og hátt 2 á A-strengnum, svo lágt 2 og hátt 2 á E-strengnum.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 5 · challenge vln-5-7 “Second finger checkup” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: In A major, where does second finger sit on the A and E strings?
rows.translation: Hvar er annar fingur á A- og E-strengjunum í A-dúr?

rows.source: Low on A, high on E
rows.translation: Lágt á A, hátt á E

rows.source: Loud and soft, slurs, your fourth finger, a first step toward vibrato, and Ode to Joy complete.
rows.translation: Sterkt og veikt, legatobogar, fjórði fingurinn, fyrsta skrefið að vibrato og allur Óðurinn til gleðinnar.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 6 “Expression” · unit summary
Violin · Unit 6 · lesson vln-6-1 “Loud and soft” · title

rows.translation: Þrjár leiðir til að spila sterkar
rows.context: Violin · Unit 6 · lesson vln-6-1 “Loud and soft” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Add arm weight, use more bow speed, and move the contact point closer to the bridge. Use all three together. For soft, do the opposite.
rows.translation: Bættu við þunga handleggsins, auktu bogahraðann og færðu snertipunktinn nær stólnum. Notaðu allt þrennt saman. Gerðu hið gagnstæða til að spila veikt.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 6 · lesson vln-6-1 “Loud and soft” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
Violin · Unit 6 · lesson vln-6-1 “Loud and soft” · step 2 (explain) · title

rows.source: Music marks loud with f, for forte, and soft with p, for piano. Growing louder is a crescendo; fading away is a diminuendo.
rows.translation: Í nótum er sterkt merkt með f, fyrir forte, og veikt með p, fyrir piano. Vaxandi styrkur er crescendo; minnkandi styrkur er diminuendo.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 6 · lesson vln-6-1 “Loud and soft” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: To play forte, where does the bow move?
rows.translation: Hvert færist boginn til að spila forte?
rows.context: Violin · Unit 6 · lesson vln-6-1 “Loud and soft” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
Violin · Unit 6 · lesson vln-6-1 “Loud and soft” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

Violin · Unit 6 · lesson vln-6-1 “Loud and soft” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Near the bridge the string takes more weight and speed, so it sounds louder without scratching.
rows.translation: Nálægt stólnum þolir strengurinn meiri þunga og hraða, svo hann hljómar sterkar án skraps.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 6 · lesson vln-6-1 “Loud and soft” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Each note twice: forte, then piano. Stay in tune while the volume changes.
rows.translation: Hver tónn tvisvar: forte og svo piano. Haltu réttri tónhæð meðan styrkurinn breytist.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 6 · lesson vln-6-1 “Loud and soft” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.translation: Langir tónar: vaxa og svo dofna
rows.context: Violin · Unit 6 · lesson vln-6-1 “Loud and soft” · step 5 (along) · title

rows.translation: Lightly Row, veikt og svo sterkt
rows.context: Violin · Unit 6 · lesson vln-6-1 “Loud and soft” · step 6 (along) · title
